generic.Defined scope/population: Bound policies awaiting the Issue job in Guidewire PolicyCenter for the assigned branch and producer code.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current issuance day with effective dates in the current or next term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Effective date, expiration date, producer code and branch present on the PolicyCenter Policy Info screen.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of policies activated matches the count of bind orders released for issuance that day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issuance timestamp and issuing user stored on the PolicyCenter policy transaction history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open issuance validation blockers logged with an owner and cleared before the Issue job runs.
generic.Test population: All policies moved from Bound to In Force in PolicyCenter during the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every activated policy shows In Force status with dates matching the bound quote to the day.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the policy to Bound and route the validation blocker to the underwriter for clearance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status is In Force and effective and expiration dates match the bind order exactly.
generic.Evidence location: PolicyCenter policy transaction history and the issuance work item in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Open the bound policy in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Search PolicyCenter by submission or quote number and open the bound policy transaction.
Confirm the record status reads Bound and not Quoted, Draft or Withdrawn.
Done when the bound policy transaction is open on screen.
verify: Check the policy number on screen matches the bind order reference.
Pass when the open record is the bound transaction named on the bind order.

steps.title: Verify effective and expiration dates on the PolicyCenter Policy Info screen
sop: Read the effective date and expiration date on the Policy Info screen.
Compare both dates against the bind order to the day and note any difference.
Done when both dates are confirmed equal to the bind order.
verify: Re-read the dates after any correction is saved.
Pass when effective and expiration dates match the bind order with no variance.

steps.title: Clear outstanding validation blockers on the PolicyCenter Issue screen
sop: Run validation on the Issue screen and list every blocking message returned.
Resolve each blocker or route it to the underwriter who owns the condition.
Done when the Issue screen returns no blocking validation messages.
verify: Re-run validation after the last fix is applied.
Pass when validation returns zero blockers on the issuance transaction.

steps.title: Run the Issue job in PolicyCenter to move the policy to In Force
sop: Execute the Issue job from the bound transaction rather than editing status directly.
Wait for the job to complete and read the resulting policy status.
Done when the policy status reads In Force.
verify: Refresh the policy summary and read the status field.
Pass when the status is In Force for the correct term.

steps.title: Confirm the policy appears on the PolicyCenter in-force listing
sop: Run the in-force listing filtered to the issuing branch and producer code.
Locate the newly activated policy on the listing.
Done when the policy is visible on the in-force listing.
verify: Compare the producer code and branch on the listing against the policy record.
Pass when the policy lists under the correct producer code and branch.

steps.title: Record the issuance timestamp and issuing user on the transaction history
sop: Open the policy transaction history in PolicyCenter after the Issue job completes.
Confirm the issuance row carries the timestamp and the performing user.
Done when the issuance row shows timestamp and user.
verify: Reopen the history from the policy summary and locate the issuance row.
Pass when the issuance row is retrievable with user and timestamp intact.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issuance documents for the policy that state and product rules permit to be electronically signed.
generic.In-scope period: Documents sent for signature between bind and the policy delivery deadline for the term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signer name, signer email and every signature and initial tag populated in the DocuSign envelope.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of signed documents returned equals the count of documents sent in the issuance envelope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: DocuSign certificate of completion stored with the signed document in OpenText.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined, expired or wet-signature-required envelopes logged with the action taken.
generic.Test population: All issuance envelopes sent through DocuSign for the policy in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every signed document carries an attached certificate of completion with no blank tags.
generic.Exception handling path: Void the envelope and route the document to wet signature where e-signature is not permitted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All required signatures applied and the certificate of completion filed with the document.
generic.Evidence location: DocuSign envelope history and the signed document record in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Check state and product e-signature permission in the policy administration system
sop: Read the risk state and product from the policy record before preparing the envelope.
Check the document type against the e-signature permission list for that state and product.
Done when e-signature permission for each document is confirmed or refused.
verify: Re-check any document flagged as wet-signature-required.
Pass when no wet-signature-required document is queued for DocuSign.

steps.title: Build the issuance envelope in DocuSign from the approved template
sop: Select the approved issuance envelope template rather than building tags manually.
Load the declarations and required notices into the envelope in document order.
Done when the envelope contains every document requiring signature.
verify: Compare the envelope document list against the issuance document checklist.
Pass when every document requiring signature is present in the envelope.

steps.title: Verify the signer identity against the policy record
sop: Read the named insured and authorised officer details from the policy record.
Compare the DocuSign signer name and email against those details.
Done when the signer is confirmed as the named insured or authorised officer.
verify: Re-read the signer email in the envelope before sending.
Pass when the signer email matches the contact held on the policy record.

steps.title: Send the DocuSign envelope and monitor for completion
sop: Send the envelope and record the envelope identifier on the issuance work item.
Monitor envelope status and chase the signer where it remains unsigned past the reminder window.
Done when the envelope status reads Completed.
verify: Open the envelope history and read the completion status.
Pass when the envelope shows Completed with no outstanding recipient.

steps.title: Confirm no blank signature or initial tab remains before download
sop: Open the completed document set returned by DocuSign.
Check every signature and initial tag is filled on every page requiring one.
Done when no blank required tag remains in the document set.
verify: Re-open the last page of each signed document.
Pass when every required tag on every document is completed.

steps.title: File the signed set and certificate of completion in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Download the signed documents and the DocuSign certificate of completion.
Index both to the policy number and term under the correct document type.
Done when signed documents and certificate are filed against the policy.
verify: Retrieve the signed document from OpenText by policy number.
Pass when the retrieved document has its certificate of completion attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every coverage line on the bound policy carrying a rated premium from the rating worksheet.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term from the bound effective date to the expiration date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium by coverage, rate book version, taxes, fees and instalment schedule populated on the premium screen.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total written premium on the declarations equals the rating engine total to the cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating worksheet with rate revision version stored against the issuance transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual premium overrides logged with the approving authority and the reason.
generic.Test population: All coverages rated on the policy in the sample issuance batch.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Premium screen totals reconcile to the rating engine output for every coverage with zero variance.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-run rating and refer unexplained variance to underwriting before the premium is applied.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Applied premium equals rated premium by coverage and the filed rate book version was used.
generic.Evidence location: Policy premium screen in the policy administration system and the rating worksheet on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Retrieve the final rating worksheet from the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the bound submission on the underwriting workstation and locate the final rating worksheet.
Confirm the worksheet is the final rated version and not a superseded indication.
Done when the final rating worksheet is retrieved for the policy.
verify: Compare the worksheet version stamp against the bind order reference.
Pass when the worksheet retrieved is the one the policy was bound on.

steps.title: Confirm the rate book version applied in the policy administration system
sop: Read the rate revision or rate book version recorded on the rating output.
Check that version is filed and effective for the policy state at the effective date.
Done when the applied rate book version is confirmed filed and effective.
verify: Cross-check the version against the filed rate register for the state.
Pass when the rate book used is filed and effective on the policy effective date.

steps.title: Enter the rated premium by coverage on the policy premium screen
sop: Copy each coverage premium from the rating worksheet to the policy premium screen.
Enter taxes, surcharges and fees as separate itemised lines from base premium.
Done when every coverage and charge line is entered on the premium screen.
verify: Compare each entered line against the worksheet line by line.
Pass when every coverage and charge line matches the rating worksheet.

steps.title: Reconcile the declarations total to the rating engine total
sop: Read the total written premium shown on the declarations page.
Compare it to the rating engine total including taxes and fees.
Done when the two totals are compared and any difference is quantified.
verify: Recompute the difference between the two totals.
Pass when the declarations total equals the rating engine total to the cent.

steps.title: Confirm the instalment schedule reflects the rated annual premium
sop: Open the instalment schedule for the selected pay plan on the policy.
Sum the scheduled instalments and compare to the rated annual premium.
Done when the schedule is confirmed to sum to the rated premium.
verify: Re-sum the instalments after any pay plan change.
Pass when the instalment schedule totals the rated annual premium plus plan fees.

steps.title: Log any manual premium override with its authority approval
sop: Identify any premium field keyed manually rather than produced by rating.
Record the override amount, reason and approving authority on the transaction.
Done when every override carries a documented approval.
verify: List overrides on the transaction and check each has an approver named.
Pass when no override remains without a documented authority approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every form, endorsement and mandatory notice listed on the policy forms schedule for the term.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term being issued, using form editions effective at the policy effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named insured, mailing address, limits, deductibles and premium populated on the declarations page.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Form count and page count in the PDF match the composition manifest and the forms schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assembled package stored in OpenText with form edition dates and assembly timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or superseded forms logged as defects and returned to composition for rebuild.
generic.Test population: All policy packages assembled for issuance in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every form on the forms schedule is present and no superseded edition appears in the package.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold release and rebuild the package where any form is missing or superseded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package contains declarations, coverage forms, endorsements and state notices in the required order.
generic.Evidence location: Assembled package record in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the policy issuance transaction.

steps.title: Pull the policy forms schedule from the policy administration system
sop: Open the issued policy and export the forms schedule for the term.
Confirm the schedule lists each form number with its edition date.
Done when the forms schedule for the term is in hand.
verify: Check the schedule is for the term being issued.
Pass when the schedule term dates match the policy being assembled.

steps.title: Assemble the package in document order in the document management repository
sop: Place the declarations page first, then coverage forms, then endorsements, then state notices.
Build the package in the repository rather than assembling locally.
Done when the package is built in the required document order.
verify: Page through the assembled PDF and check section order.
Pass when the package order is declarations, forms, endorsements, then notices.

steps.title: Tick each form number on the schedule against the assembled PDF
sop: Work down the forms schedule and locate each form number in the PDF.
Mark any form on the schedule that is absent from the PDF as a defect.
Done when every schedule line is ticked or raised as a defect.
verify: Recount the forms present in the PDF against the schedule line count.
Pass when every form on the schedule is present in the package.

steps.title: Confirm the mandatory state notice set for the risk state is included
sop: Look up the mandatory notice set for the risk state and product.
Check privacy, fraud warning and OFAC notices where applicable are in the package.
Done when every mandatory notice for the state is confirmed present.
verify: Re-check the notice list against the state requirement table.
Pass when no mandatory state notice is missing from the package.

steps.title: Check declarations data against the policy record in the administration system
sop: Compare named insured, mailing address, limits and deductibles on the declarations to the policy record.
Compare the premium shown to the policy premium screen total.
Done when every declarations field is compared to the policy record.
verify: Re-read any field corrected after the comparison.
Pass when all declarations fields agree with the policy record.

steps.title: Reconcile page count and bookmarks to the composition manifest in OpenText
sop: Read the expected page count and bookmark set from the composition manifest.
Compare them against the assembled package in OpenText.
Done when page count and bookmarks are compared to the manifest.
verify: Recount pages in the released package.
Pass when page count and bookmarks match the manifest exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound submissions in PolicyCenter awaiting a policy number for the product and risk state.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions bound in the current issuance cycle and not yet numbered.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line-of-business prefix, state prefix and submission link populated on the numbered policy record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of numbers issued equals the count of bound submissions released for numbering.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Number assignment row with user and timestamp held on the PolicyCenter transaction history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate or out-of-sequence number attempts logged with the corrective action taken.
generic.Test population: All policy numbers assigned from the PolicyCenter sequence in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every number comes from the system sequence and no duplicate exists across active policies.
generic.Exception handling path: Void the number and re-draw from the sequence where a clash or manual key is detected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Number is system generated, correctly prefixed and linked to the originating submission.
generic.Evidence location: PolicyCenter policy record and its linked submission and quote references.

steps.title: Open the bound submission in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Locate the bound submission awaiting numbering in the issuance queue.
Confirm the product and risk state on the submission header.
Done when the correct bound submission is open.
verify: Check the submission number against the issuance work item.
Pass when the open submission is the one on the work item.

steps.title: Generate the policy number from the PolicyCenter sequence
sop: Trigger number assignment from the system sequence rather than keying a number.
Do not reuse a number from a cancelled or withdrawn submission.
Done when the system has returned a policy number.
verify: Check the number field was populated by the system and is read only.
Pass when the number was drawn from the sequence and not keyed manually.

steps.title: Confirm the line-of-business and state prefix on the assigned number
sop: Read the prefix segment of the assigned number.
Compare it to the numbering standard for the product and risk state.
Done when the prefix is confirmed correct for product and state.
verify: Re-check the prefix against the numbering standard table.
Pass when the prefix matches the product and state standard.

steps.title: Search PolicyCenter for an existing use of the assigned number
sop: Search the policy index for the assigned number across all statuses.
Check no active policy or prior cancelled submission already holds it.
Done when the number is confirmed unused elsewhere.
verify: Re-run the search after assignment is committed.
Pass when the number returns exactly one policy record.

steps.title: Link the policy number to the submission and quote in the policy record
sop: Record the originating submission number and quote number on the policy record.
Confirm the links resolve from the policy back to the submission.
Done when submission and quote links are saved on the policy.
verify: Navigate from the policy to the submission using the link.
Pass when the link opens the originating submission.

steps.title: Confirm the declarations shows the assigned policy number
sop: Open the generated declarations page for the policy.
Compare the number printed on it to the administration system record.
Done when both numbers have been compared.
verify: Re-read the declarations header after any regeneration.
Pass when the declarations number equals the system policy number.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issuance work items in the workflow tool whose policy has been issued and documents despatched.
generic.In-scope period: Work items completed within the current issuance SLA reporting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closure reason code, completion date and attached issued documents populated on the work item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of closed issuance work items equals the count of policies issued in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued policy documents attached to the work item with the closure timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Work items closed with open subtasks logged and reopened with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All issuance work items closed in the workflow tool during the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every closed item carries reason Issued Complete and the issued documents as attachments.
generic.Exception handling path: Reopen the work item and complete the outstanding subtask before closing again.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All subtasks complete, documents attached and closure reason set to Issued Complete.
generic.Evidence location: Issuance work item in the workflow tool and the policy record in the administration system.

steps.title: Open the issuance work item in the workflow tool
sop: Locate the issuance work item for the issued policy number.
Confirm the item is the current issuance case and not a superseded one.
Done when the correct issuance work item is open.
verify: Check the policy number on the work item against the issued policy.
Pass when the work item references the issued policy.

steps.title: Confirm every subtask on the work item is complete
sop: List the subtasks on the work item and read each status.
Complete or reassign any subtask still open.
Done when no subtask remains in an open state.
verify: Refresh the subtask list after the last update.
Pass when every subtask reads complete.

steps.title: Attach the issued policy documents to the work item
sop: Retrieve the issued document set from the policy administration system.
Attach the set to the work item as the closing artefact.
Done when the issued documents are attached to the work item.
verify: Open the attachment from the work item.
Pass when the attached document set opens and matches the issued policy.

steps.title: Record the issuance completion date against the SLA clock
sop: Read the SLA clock start recorded at bind on the work item.
Enter the issuance completion date and confirm the elapsed time calculates.
Done when the completion date is recorded and elapsed time shows.
verify: Re-read the elapsed time field after saving.
Pass when elapsed time is calculated from the bind SLA start.

steps.title: Set the closure reason code to Issued Complete
sop: Select Issued Complete from the closure reason list.
Do not accept a default cancel or withdraw code.
Done when the closure reason reads Issued Complete.
verify: Re-read the closure reason on the closed item.
Pass when the reason code is Issued Complete.

steps.title: Confirm no pended item or missing-document flag remains on the queue
sop: Filter the issuance queue for this policy number across all statuses.
Clear or reassign any residual pended item or missing-document flag.
Done when the queue holds no open item for the policy.
verify: Re-run the queue filter after closure.
Pass when no open item for the policy remains on the issuance queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policy packages despatched to insureds and producers awaiting a delivery acknowledgment.
generic.In-scope period: Packages despatched within the current follow-up window for delivery confirmation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acknowledgment date, delivery channel and recipient recorded on the policy delivery record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of acknowledgments logged reconciles to the count of packages despatched in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Email or portal read receipt or tracked mail record stored against the policy in OpenText.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced or undeliverable addresses logged and escalated to the producer with the outcome.
generic.Test population: All policy packages despatched in the sample period requiring acknowledgment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every despatch has an acknowledgment date and channel or a logged escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: Chase after the follow-up window and escalate undeliverable addresses to the producer.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgment date and channel recorded and no unresolved undeliverable status remains.
generic.Evidence location: Policy delivery record in the administration system and the send log in the CRM.

steps.title: Pull the despatch send log for the policy from the CRM
sop: Open the policy contact record in the CRM and list the package despatches.
Note the channel and despatch date for each despatch.
Done when the despatch entries for the policy are listed.
verify: Compare the despatch list to the policy delivery record.
Pass when every despatch on the policy appears in the send log.

steps.title: Check the email or portal read receipt against the send log
sop: Open the delivery receipt or portal read receipt for each electronic despatch.
Match the receipt to its send log entry by recipient and date.
Done when each electronic despatch has its receipt checked.
verify: Re-open any despatch with no matched receipt.
Pass when every electronic despatch has a matched receipt or a logged chase.

steps.title: Record the tracked mail number and delivery date for mailed packages
sop: Retrieve the certified or tracked mail record for each mailed package.
Record the tracking number and the delivery date shown by the carrier.
Done when tracking number and delivery date are recorded for each mailed package.
verify: Re-check the carrier status for any package showing in transit.
Pass when each mailed package has a delivery date or an active chase.

steps.title: Log the acknowledgment date on the policy delivery record
sop: Enter the acknowledgment date and channel on the policy delivery record.
Attach the receipt or tracking evidence to the record.
Done when acknowledgment date and channel are saved with evidence.
verify: Reopen the delivery record from the policy.
Pass when the acknowledgment date and channel are retrievable with evidence attached.

steps.title: Chase packages with no acknowledgment after the follow-up window
sop: List despatches past the follow-up window with no acknowledgment recorded.
Send a chase to the recipient and record the chase date on the policy.
Done when every overdue despatch has a recorded chase.
verify: Re-run the overdue list after the chase run.
Pass when no despatch is past the follow-up window without a logged chase.

steps.title: Escalate undeliverable addresses to the producer and record the outcome
sop: Identify despatches returned as bounced or undeliverable.
Notify the producer of record for address correction and log the notification.
Done when every undeliverable despatch is escalated and logged.
verify: Re-check the status of each escalated despatch after re-send.
Pass when no undeliverable status remains unresolved past the follow-up window.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every form number and edition on the policy forms schedule for the risk state being issued.
generic.In-scope period: Filing status assessed as at the policy effective date for the term being issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date and filing reference number recorded on the issuance checklist.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of forms checked equals the count of forms on the policy forms schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filing reference and lookup date recorded against each form on the issuance checklist.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Forms with pending or withdrawn filings referred to product compliance with the outcome logged.
generic.Test population: All forms on the issued policy schedule for the risk state in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issued form has an approved filing reference valid on the policy effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold issuance and refer the form to product compliance before the package is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each form is Approved or Filed and Effective at the effective date with its reference recorded.
generic.Evidence location: State filing register lookup results and the issuance checklist on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Export the policy forms schedule from the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy and export the forms schedule with form numbers and edition dates.
Confirm the schedule covers the term being issued.
Done when the forms schedule is exported for checking.
verify: Compare the export line count to the schedule shown on the policy.
Pass when the export contains every form on the policy schedule.

steps.title: Look up each form on the state filing register from the underwriting workstation
sop: Search the filing register by form number and edition date for the risk state.
Read the filing status returned for each form.
Done when every form on the schedule has a register status.
verify: Recount the forms looked up against the schedule.
Pass when no form on the schedule is left without a register status.

steps.title: Confirm each filing status is valid at the policy effective date
sop: Compare the filing effective date to the policy effective date for each form.
Mark forms whose filing is Approved or Filed and Effective at that date.
Done when each form is marked valid or invalid at the effective date.
verify: Re-check any form whose filing effective date is close to the policy date.
Pass when every form is confirmed valid on the policy effective date.

steps.title: Check the state amendatory endorsement is on the package
sop: Identify the amendatory endorsement required for the risk state and product.
Confirm it appears on the forms schedule for the policy.
Done when the required amendatory endorsement is confirmed present or added.
verify: Re-read the schedule after any addition.
Pass when the state amendatory endorsement is on the forms schedule.

steps.title: Record filing reference numbers on the issuance checklist
sop: Enter the filing reference number against each form on the issuance checklist.
Record the date the register lookup was performed.
Done when every form line carries a filing reference and lookup date.
verify: Scan the checklist for blank reference fields.
Pass when no form line is left without a filing reference.

steps.title: Refer expired or pending filings to product compliance
sop: List forms whose filing is expired, pending or withdrawn.
Raise a referral to product compliance and hold issuance for those forms.
Done when every non-approved form is referred and issuance is held.
verify: Re-read the referral outcomes before release.
Pass when no form with a pending or withdrawn filing remains in the package.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issued policy packages due for delivery to the insured and the producer of record.
generic.In-scope period: Packages due for despatch within the delivery standard following policy issuance.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Delivery preference, mailing address, agency of record address and consent flag populated on the policy.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of despatches logged equals two per policy, one insured copy and one producer copy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Despatch date, channel and recipient recorded on the policy delivery log with the package version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing electronic consent or invalid addresses logged with the alternative channel used.
generic.Test population: All policy packages despatched in the sample period across all channels.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every policy shows an insured and a producer despatch with channel, recipient and date.
generic.Exception handling path: Route to paper delivery where electronic consent is absent and record the reason.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package despatched on the recorded preference to the correct addresses with the log completed.
generic.Evidence location: Policy delivery log in the administration system and the despatch record in the CRM.

steps.title: Read the delivery preference flag on the policy record
sop: Open the policy in the administration system and read the delivery preference field.
Note whether the preference is paper, email or portal.
Done when the delivery preference for the policy is established.
verify: Re-read the preference field before routing.
Pass when the routing channel selected equals the recorded preference.

steps.title: Confirm electronic delivery consent before any electronic-only send
sop: Check the electronic consent flag and consent date on the policy record.
Route to paper where consent is absent rather than sending electronically.
Done when consent status is confirmed for the chosen channel.
verify: Re-check consent for every electronic despatch queued.
Pass when no electronic-only despatch exists without consent on file.

steps.title: Retrieve the assembled package from OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Retrieve the released package version indexed to the policy and term.
Confirm it is the released version and not a draft or superseded build.
Done when the released package is retrieved for despatch.
verify: Compare the package version stamp to the issuance transaction.
Pass when the retrieved package is the released version for the term.

steps.title: Despatch the insured copy to the mailing address on the declarations
sop: Compare the despatch address to the mailing address on the declarations page.
Send the package on the recorded preference channel to that address.
Done when the insured copy is despatched to the declarations address.
verify: Re-read the despatch address on the send record.
Pass when the despatch address equals the declarations mailing address.

steps.title: Despatch the producer copy to the agency of record address
sop: Read the agency of record address from the producer record in the CRM.
Send the producer copy to that address and not to a personal address.
Done when the producer copy is despatched to the agency of record.
verify: Compare the producer despatch address to the producer record.
Pass when the producer copy went to the agency of record address.

steps.title: Record despatch date, channel and recipient on the policy delivery log
sop: Enter a delivery log line for the insured copy and one for the producer copy.
Record date, channel and recipient on each line.
Done when both despatches are logged with date, channel and recipient.
verify: Reopen the delivery log from the policy record.
Pass when the log shows two complete despatch lines for the policy.

generic.Defined scope/population: Delivery receipts, tracking confirmations and portal acknowledgments for issued policy terms.
generic.In-scope period: Proofs generated for despatches made in the current issued policy term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recipient, address, delivery date, policy number and term populated on the indexed proof.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of proofs filed reconciles to the count of despatches on the policy delivery log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof stored in OpenText with the policy-file retention class and an index timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Despatches without an obtainable proof logged with the reason and the substitute evidence.
generic.Test population: All issued policy terms in the sample period requiring a proof of delivery.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issued term has at least one proof of delivery indexed under the correct document type.
generic.Exception handling path: Request a duplicate proof from the carrier or portal and log the gap until it is received.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Proof indexed to the policy term as Proof of Delivery and retrievable from the policy document list.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt proof record linked to the policy issuance transaction.

steps.title: Collect the delivery proof artefact for each despatch
sop: Gather the delivery receipt, carrier tracking confirmation or portal acknowledgment.
Confirm the artefact relates to the policy and term being filed.
Done when a proof artefact is held for each despatch.
verify: Compare the artefact count to the policy delivery log lines.
Pass when every logged despatch has a proof artefact collected.

steps.title: Confirm the proof shows recipient, address and delivery date
sop: Open each proof and read the recipient, address and delivery date on its face.
Reject any proof that does not show all three fields.
Done when each proof is confirmed to show all three fields.
verify: Re-open any proof rejected and replaced.
Pass when every filed proof shows recipient, address and delivery date.

steps.title: Index the proof in OpenText under document type Proof of Delivery
sop: Upload the proof to OpenText and set the document type to Proof of Delivery.
Index it to the policy number and the term dates.
Done when the proof is indexed under the correct document type.
verify: Search OpenText by policy number and document type.
Pass when the search returns the filed proof for the term.

steps.title: Apply the policy-file retention class to the filed proof
sop: Set the retention class on the proof record to the policy-file statutory class.
Confirm the retention expiry date calculated is the statutory period.
Done when the retention class and expiry are set on the record.
verify: Re-read the retention fields on the saved record.
Pass when the retention class and expiry match the statutory requirement.

steps.title: Link the proof to the issuance transaction in the policy administration system
sop: Attach or link the OpenText proof record to the issuance transaction.
Confirm the link resolves from the policy to the proof.
Done when the proof is linked to the issuance transaction.
verify: Open the policy document list and locate the proof.
Pass when the proof surfaces in the policy document list.

steps.title: Reconcile filed proofs to the policy delivery log
sop: Compare filed proof records against the despatch lines on the delivery log.
Raise a gap entry for any despatch without a filed proof.
Done when every despatch is matched or a gap is raised.
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after gaps are closed.
Pass when no issued term is left without a proof-of-delivery artefact.

generic.Defined scope/population: Document set required for the issued policy transaction under the product and state template rules.
generic.In-scope period: Documents generated for the term being issued using templates effective at the effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured name, address, limits, deductible and premium merge fields resolved in the generated PDF.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of documents written back to the policy equals the count the composition job produced.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated set stored with template version and composition run timestamp on the transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Composition warnings and unresolved placeholders logged with the regeneration outcome.
generic.Test population: All composition runs fired from issuance transactions in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every generated document uses the current template version and contains no merge placeholders.
generic.Exception handling path: Discard the output, correct the source data or template and re-run the composition job.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documents generated from the issued transaction and attached with correct document types.
generic.Evidence location: Policy document list in the administration system and the document record in OpenText.

steps.title: Trigger the composition job from the issued policy transaction
sop: Open the issued policy transaction in the administration system.
Launch the composition job from the transaction rather than a manual template.
Done when the composition job has been submitted from the transaction.
verify: Read the job source reference on the composition log.
Pass when the job source is the issuance transaction.

steps.title: Confirm the composition engine selected the current template version
sop: Read the template version stamped on the composition run log.
Compare it to the current approved template for the product and state.
Done when the template version used is confirmed current.
verify: Re-check the template register for the product and state.
Pass when the run used the current approved template version.

steps.title: Open the generated PDF and spot-check the merge fields
sop: Open the generated document and read insured name, address, limits, deductible and premium.
Compare each against the policy record.
Done when all five merge fields have been compared.
verify: Re-read any field corrected and regenerated.
Pass when all spot-checked merge fields agree with the policy record.

steps.title: Review the composition log for warnings and missing variables
sop: Open the composition run log and list warnings and missing-variable messages.
Investigate each message rather than accepting the output.
Done when every warning has been reviewed and dispositioned.
verify: Re-read the log after regeneration.
Pass when the composition run completes with no unresolved warnings.

steps.title: Scan the generated set for unresolved placeholders
sop: Search the generated PDFs for placeholder markers and empty merge tokens.
Reject any document containing an unresolved placeholder.
Done when every generated document is scanned for placeholders.
verify: Re-scan the regenerated documents.
Pass when no generated document contains an unresolved merge placeholder.

steps.title: Confirm write-back to the policy document list with correct document types
sop: Open the policy document list after the run completes.
Check each generated document is present with the correct document type.
Done when every generated document appears with its correct type.
verify: Recount documents in the list against the composition manifest.
Pass when the document list matches the manifest by count and type.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issuance events posted on policies issued in the administration system for the tenant.
generic.In-scope period: Issuance transactions posted within the audit reporting period under review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: User, timestamp, transaction type Issue, bound quote reference and issued premium populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of issuance audit rows equals the count of policies issued in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Immutable audit row retained on the policy history with user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Issuance overrides named in the audit entry with the approver and the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All issuance transactions posted to policy history in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issuance audit entry names a performing user and shows the issued premium.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a data defect where an audit entry is missing a user and correct at source.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit entry holds user, timestamp, transaction type and premium and cannot be edited.
generic.Evidence location: Policy history screen in the administration system and the workflow tool case record.

steps.title: Open the policy history screen after issuance
sop: Open the issued policy in the administration system and select policy history.
Locate the row created by the issuance transaction.
Done when the issuance history row is displayed.
verify: Compare the row transaction type to the issuance action performed.
Pass when the row is the issuance transaction for this term.

steps.title: Confirm the audit row carries user, timestamp and transaction type Issue
sop: Read the user, timestamp and transaction type fields on the issuance row.
Raise a defect where any of the three is blank.
Done when all three fields have been read and confirmed populated.
verify: Re-read the row after any correction is applied.
Pass when user, timestamp and transaction type are all populated.

steps.title: Check the entry captures the bound quote reference and issued premium
sop: Read the quote reference and premium recorded on the audit entry.
Compare both to the bind order and the policy premium screen.
Done when quote reference and premium are compared to source.
verify: Recompute the premium comparison after any premium correction.
Pass when the audit premium equals the issued policy premium.

steps.title: Confirm manual overrides are named with their approver
sop: List any override applied during issuance from the transaction detail.
Check each override is named in the audit entry with its approver.
Done when every override is confirmed named with an approver.
verify: Re-read the override section of the audit entry.
Pass when no override appears without a named approver.

steps.title: Confirm the audit entry is not editable in the servicing UI
sop: Open the audit entry under a servicing user profile.
Confirm no edit or delete control is exposed on the entry.
Done when the absence of edit controls is confirmed.
verify: Attempt to open the entry in edit mode as a servicing user.
Pass when the entry is read only for servicing users.

steps.title: Spot-check retrieval of the entry from the policy history for the term
sop: Navigate to the policy history for the issued term from the policy summary.
Locate the issuance entry without using a direct link.
Done when the entry is retrieved through the standard history screen.
verify: Repeat the retrieval on a second policy from the same batch.
Pass when the issuance entry is retrievable for the term on each sampled policy.

generic.Defined scope/population: New business issuance transactions to be posted to the policy ledger in the administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Accounting period containing the policy effective date for the issued term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transaction type, effective date, written premium and producer code populated on the ledger row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Written premium posted equals the issued policy premium and the transaction count equals policies issued.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ledger posting retained with posting timestamp and accounting period stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Transactions in error status on the interface monitor logged with the reprocessing outcome.
generic.Test population: All New Business Issue transactions posted in the sample accounting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issuance posts as New Business Issue in the correct period with no error status.
generic.Exception handling path: Reprocess the failed transaction from the interface monitor and escalate persistent failures.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Transaction posted with correct type, period, premium and commission-bearing producer code.
generic.Evidence location: Policy transaction ledger in Guidewire PolicyCenter and the interface monitor queue.

steps.title: Post the issuance transaction to the policy ledger in PolicyCenter
sop: Commit the issuance transaction so it writes to the policy transaction ledger.
Confirm the effective date on the ledger row equals the policy effective date.
Done when the transaction appears on the ledger with the correct effective date.
verify: Reopen the ledger and locate the posted row.
Pass when the ledger row shows the policy effective date.

steps.title: Confirm the transaction type is New Business Issue
sop: Read the transaction type code on the posted ledger row.
Reject correction or rewrite codes used in place of New Business Issue.
Done when the transaction type is confirmed as New Business Issue.
verify: Re-read the type code after any repost.
Pass when the ledger row type is New Business Issue.

steps.title: Check written premium posted to the correct accounting period
sop: Read the accounting period stamped on the posted premium.
Compare it to the period containing the policy effective date.
Done when the posting period has been compared to the effective date period.
verify: Re-check the period after any date correction.
Pass when written premium sits in the period of the effective date.

steps.title: Verify the producer code that will drive commission
sop: Read the producer code on the posted transaction.
Compare it to the producer of record on the policy.
Done when the producer code has been compared to the policy record.
verify: Re-read the code after any producer correction.
Pass when the transaction producer code equals the policy producer of record.

steps.title: Check the interface monitor for pending or errored status
sop: Open the interface monitor and filter to the issued policy number.
Read the status of each outbound message for the transaction.
Done when every message status has been read.
verify: Re-run the filter after any reprocess.
Pass when no message for the policy remains in error or pending status.

steps.title: Reconcile posted premium to the issued policy premium
sop: Sum the premium posted on the ledger for the issuance transaction.
Compare it to the total on the policy premium screen.
Done when both totals have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any adjustment.
Pass when posted premium equals issued policy premium to the cent.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assembled policy packages awaiting quality review before release to the insured.
generic.In-scope period: Packages presented for review in the current issuance review cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Limits, deductibles, forms, effective dates and reviewer name populated on the issuance checklist.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of packages reviewed equals the count of packages presented for release.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quality review result with reviewer name and review date held on the issuance checklist.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Discrepancies raised as defect codes and returned to issuance with the resolution recorded.
generic.Test population: All policy packages quality reviewed in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No package is released while an open quality defect remains against it.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the package to issuance under a defect code rather than correcting it silently.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Declarations reconcile to the bind authority letter and all state notices are present.
generic.Evidence location: Issuance checklist in the administration system and the reviewed package in OpenText.

steps.title: Retrieve the bind authority letter from the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the bound submission and retrieve the bind authority letter.
Confirm it is the final version signed by the binding underwriter.
Done when the final bind authority letter is retrieved.
verify: Compare the letter reference to the bind order on the policy.
Pass when the letter matches the bind order for the policy.

steps.title: Compare declarations terms against the bind authority letter
sop: Compare limits, deductibles, forms and effective dates line by line.
Mark any difference as a discrepancy on the review sheet.
Done when every term has been compared and differences marked.
verify: Re-compare any term after correction.
Pass when declarations terms agree with the bind authority letter.

steps.title: Confirm the binding underwriter held authority per the matrix
sop: Read the issued premium and limits from the policy record.
Compare them to the binding underwriter authority level in the matrix.
Done when the authority comparison has been completed.
verify: Re-read the matrix row relied upon.
Pass when the binding underwriter authority covers the premium and limits issued.

steps.title: Check mandatory state notices are present in the package
sop: List the mandatory notices for the risk state and product.
Confirm each is present in the assembled package in OpenText.
Done when every mandatory notice has been checked.
verify: Re-check the notice list after any rebuild.
Pass when no mandatory state notice is missing from the package.

steps.title: Record the review result and reviewer name on the issuance checklist
sop: Enter the review outcome, reviewer name and review date on the checklist.
Attach the marked-up review sheet where discrepancies were found.
Done when the result and reviewer are recorded on the checklist.
verify: Reopen the checklist from the policy record.
Pass when the review outcome and reviewer name are retrievable.

steps.title: Return defective packages to issuance under a defect code
sop: Raise a defect code for each discrepancy found in review.
Return the package to issuance rather than editing it in place.
Done when every discrepancy is raised as a defect and returned.
verify: Re-check the defect list before release.
Pass when no package is released with an open quality defect.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound risk packages handed from underwriting to issuance for the product and branch.
generic.In-scope period: Packages received in the current issuance intake day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bind order, signed application, rating worksheet and dated bind approval present on the package.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of packages received equals the count of bind orders released by underwriting.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Receipt acknowledgment with timestamp recorded on the issuance work item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Packages missing a mandatory artefact rejected to underwriting with a reason code.
generic.Test population: All bound risk packages received into issuance in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every accepted package holds bind order, signed application and rating worksheet.
generic.Exception handling path: Reject to underwriting with a reason code and hold the SLA clock until resubmission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated bind approval on or before the requested effective date with subjectivities recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Issuance work item in the workflow tool and the bound submission on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Open the bound risk package on the underwriting workstation
sop: Locate the released bound package for the submission in the handoff queue.
Confirm the package relates to the submission on the issuance work item.
Done when the correct bound package is open.
verify: Compare the submission number on package and work item.
Pass when both reference the same submission.

steps.title: Confirm bind order, signed application and rating worksheet are present
sop: Check the package contents against the mandatory artefact list.
Mark any missing artefact for rejection.
Done when all three mandatory artefacts are confirmed present or flagged.
verify: Re-check the artefact list after any resubmission.
Pass when all three artefacts are present on the accepted package.

steps.title: Check the underwriter bind approval date against the effective date
sop: Read the bind approval and its signature date.
Compare it to the requested policy effective date.
Done when the approval date has been compared to the effective date.
verify: Re-read the approval date after any correction.
Pass when the bind approval is dated on or before the effective date.

steps.title: Record bind subjectivities as open items with due dates on the policy
sop: List the subjectivities stated at bind on the package.
Create an open item with a due date on the policy for each.
Done when every subjectivity is recorded as an open item.
verify: Recount the open items against the subjectivity list.
Pass when every bind subjectivity has a matching open item.

steps.title: Acknowledge receipt and start the issuance SLA clock
sop: Acknowledge receipt to underwriting on the workflow tool handoff.
Start the issuance SLA clock on the work item with the receipt timestamp.
Done when receipt is acknowledged and the SLA clock is running.
verify: Re-read the SLA start on the work item.
Pass when the SLA clock start equals the receipt timestamp.

steps.title: Reject incomplete packages to underwriting with a reason code
sop: Select the reason code matching the missing mandatory artefact.
Return the package to underwriting and record the rejection on the work item.
Done when every incomplete package is rejected with a reason code.
verify: Re-check the issuance queue for accepted but incomplete packages.
Pass when no issuance is started on a package lacking a dated bind approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved forms and endorsements applicable to the product, risk state and effective date.
generic.In-scope period: Form editions approved and effective at the policy effective date being issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date and attachment reason populated on the saved forms schedule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms on the saved schedule equal bound endorsements plus mandatory auto-attaching forms.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Forms schedule saved to the policy with edition dates and the retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Forms unavailable in the approved library logged and referred to product before use.
generic.Test population: All forms retrieved for policies issued in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every form on the schedule came from the approved forms library with a current edition.
generic.Exception handling path: Halt retrieval and refer to product compliance rather than using a local or saved copy.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Forms schedule saved to the policy listing each form number and edition date.
generic.Evidence location: Policy forms schedule in the administration system and the forms library record in OpenText.

steps.title: Open the approved forms library for the product and state
sop: Open the forms library filtered by product, risk state and effective date.
Do not use a locally saved or emailed copy of any form.
Done when the approved library view for the product and state is open.
verify: Check the library filter values against the policy record.
Pass when the library view matches the policy product, state and effective date.

steps.title: Confirm each form edition date is currently approved for the state
sop: Read the edition date returned for each form in the library.
Compare it to the approved edition for the risk state at the effective date.
Done when every form edition has been compared.
verify: Re-check any form whose edition changed recently.
Pass when every retrieved edition is the approved edition for the state.

steps.title: Add the bound endorsements named on the bind order
sop: Read the endorsement list from the bind order.
Add each named endorsement to the policy forms list.
Done when every bound endorsement is on the forms list.
verify: Compare the forms list endorsements to the bind order list.
Pass when the endorsements on the policy equal those on the bind order.

steps.title: Remove endorsements not bound from the forms list
sop: Identify endorsements on the list that do not appear on the bind order.
Remove each one and note the removal on the work item.
Done when no unbound endorsement remains on the list.
verify: Re-compare the list against the bind order.
Pass when the forms list carries no endorsement absent from the bind order.

steps.title: Check mandatory auto-attaching forms were added by the forms engine
sop: Run the forms engine and list the mandatory auto-attaching forms for the risk.
Confirm each appears on the policy forms list.
Done when every mandatory auto-attaching form is confirmed present.
verify: Re-run the forms engine after any manual edit.
Pass when no mandatory auto-attaching form is missing.

steps.title: Save the forms schedule to the policy so it prints on the declarations
sop: Save the resulting forms schedule against the policy term.
Confirm the schedule is flagged to print on the declarations page.
Done when the schedule is saved and flagged to print.
verify: Open the generated declarations and read the forms schedule section.
Pass when the declarations lists every form number and edition date saved.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issued policies with commission-bearing premium due for extract to the commission platform.
generic.In-scope period: Policies issued within the current compensation feed run window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, producer code, written premium and commission rate populated on each feed record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Record count sent equals the record count accepted on the downstream interface log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Feed run timestamp and reference recorded on the policy transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected compensation records logged with the correction and reprocessing outcome.
generic.Test population: All compensation feed records generated in the sample feed run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issued policy in the run is accepted by the commission platform with no unreprocessed rejects.
generic.Exception handling path: Correct the source data and reprocess the rejected record before the payment cycle closes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Feed record for the policy accepted downstream with the run timestamp recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Commission platform interface log and the policy transaction in the administration system.

steps.title: Trigger the compensation extract for the issued policy
sop: Run the compensation extract for the issuance batch in the billing platform.
Confirm the issued policy is included in the extract population.
Done when the extract has run and includes the policy.
verify: Search the extract output for the policy number.
Pass when the policy appears in the extract file.

steps.title: Check the feed record carries the required fields
sop: Open the feed record and read policy number, producer code, written premium and commission rate.
Flag any blank or defaulted field for correction.
Done when all four fields have been read and confirmed populated.
verify: Re-read the record after any correction.
Pass when all four required fields are populated and valid.

steps.title: Confirm the feed landed in the commission platform
sop: Open the commission platform inbound log for the run.
Locate the policy record in the received file.
Done when the record is confirmed received downstream.
verify: Re-check the inbound log after the run completes.
Pass when the record shows as received in the commission platform.

steps.title: Reconcile record counts sent against records received
sop: Read the count of records sent from the extract control total.
Compare it to the count received on the interface log.
Done when the two counts have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any resend.
Pass when the sent and received counts are equal.

steps.title: Investigate and reprocess rejected records
sop: List records rejected by the compensation platform with their reject reasons.
Correct the source data and resubmit each rejected record.
Done when every rejected record has been corrected and resubmitted.
verify: Re-read the reject queue after resubmission.
Pass when no rejected compensation record remains unreprocessed.

steps.title: Record the feed run timestamp on the policy transaction
sop: Enter the feed run reference and timestamp on the policy transaction.
Confirm the entry allows the payment cycle to be traced from the policy.
Done when the run timestamp is recorded on the transaction.
verify: Reopen the policy transaction and read the feed reference.
Pass when the feed run timestamp and reference are retrievable from the policy.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issued first-term policies with a producer of record due a new-business commission calculation.
generic.In-scope period: Policies issued within the current commission calculation cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Producer code, licence and appointment status, commission schedule and split percentages populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Split commission percentages across producers total 100% on every split policy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation trigger date and schedule version recorded on the commission record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unappointed or unlicensed producers logged and held from calculation until resolved.
generic.Test population: All commission calculations initiated in the sample cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every calculation runs against a currently appointed and licensed producer at the schedule rate.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold the calculation and route the appointment or licence gap to producer administration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New-business rate from the producer agreement applied with the trigger date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Commission record in the billing platform and the producer record in the administration system.

steps.title: Confirm producer licence and appointment in the policy state
sop: Open the producer record and read licence and appointment status for the policy state.
Confirm both are current as at the policy effective date.
Done when licence and appointment status are confirmed current.
verify: Re-read the status after any producer record update.
Pass when the producer is licensed and appointed in the policy state.

steps.title: Retrieve the commission schedule from the producer agreement
sop: Open the producer agreement and read the schedule for this product and term.
Confirm the schedule version is the one in force at the effective date.
Done when the applicable commission schedule is retrieved.
verify: Compare the schedule version to the agreement effective dates.
Pass when the schedule retrieved is in force at the policy effective date.

steps.title: Confirm the new-business rate rather than the renewal rate applies
sop: Check the policy term sequence to confirm this is a first term.
Select the new-business rate from the schedule for a first term.
Done when the rate basis has been selected and recorded.
verify: Re-read the rate applied on the commission record.
Pass when a first-term policy carries the new-business rate.

steps.title: Check split commission percentages total 100%
sop: List the producers sharing commission on the policy and their percentages.
Sum the percentages and correct any shortfall or excess.
Done when the split percentages have been summed.
verify: Recompute the sum after any correction.
Pass when split percentages total exactly 100% where a split is recorded.

steps.title: Initiate the commission calculation in the billing platform
sop: Trigger the calculation for the policy against the selected schedule.
Confirm the calculation completes without an error status.
Done when the calculation has been initiated and completed.
verify: Read the calculation status on the commission record.
Pass when the calculation completed against the appointed producer.

steps.title: Record the calculation trigger date for the commission cycle
sop: Record the trigger date on the commission record and the policy transaction.
Confirm the date falls inside the intended commission payment cycle.
Done when the trigger date is recorded on both records.
verify: Re-read the cycle assignment on the commission record.
Pass when the calculation falls in the intended commission cycle.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every coverage, limit, deductible and date field on the issuance record against the bound quote.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term from the bound effective date to the bound expiration date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Limits, sub-limits, deductibles, coinsurance, dates and named insured details populated on the policy.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of coverages on the policy equals the count of coverages on the bound quote.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation record retained on the issuance transaction with the comparison date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances recorded as exceptions with the underwriter approval reference before issuance proceeds.
generic.Test population: All policies validated against their bound quote in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unexplained variance between issued coverage terms and the bound quote.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold issuance and obtain an underwriter approval reference for any accepted variance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Limits, deductibles and dates reconciled to the bound quote and the reconciliation recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Validation record on the issuance transaction and the bound quote on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Retrieve the bound quote from the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the bound submission and retrieve the quote the policy was bound on.
Confirm it is the bound version and not a superseded option.
Done when the bound quote is retrieved for comparison.
verify: Compare the quote reference to the bind order.
Pass when the retrieved quote is the bound quote on the bind order.

steps.title: Compare coverage limits line by line on the policy screen
sop: Work down the coverage list on the policy and compare each limit to the quote.
Record any difference on the validation sheet.
Done when every coverage limit has been compared.
verify: Recount the coverages compared against the quote coverage count.
Pass when every quoted coverage has a matching policy limit.

steps.title: Confirm deductibles, sub-limits and coinsurance match the quote
sop: Compare deductibles, sub-limits and coinsurance percentages field by field.
Record any difference as a variance for approval.
Done when all three attribute groups have been compared.
verify: Re-compare after any correction is applied.
Pass when deductibles, sub-limits and coinsurance match the bound quote exactly.

steps.title: Check effective and expiration dates and term length against the bind order
sop: Read effective date, expiration date and term length from the policy.
Compare each to the bind order values.
Done when all three date attributes have been compared.
verify: Re-read the dates after any correction.
Pass when dates and term length equal the bind order.

steps.title: Verify named insured legal name, entity type and address against the application
sop: Read the named insured details from the signed application.
Compare legal name, entity type and mailing address to the policy record.
Done when all three insured attributes have been compared.
verify: Re-read the policy insured block after correction.
Pass when insured legal name, entity type and address match the application.

steps.title: Record variances as exceptions with the underwriter approval reference
sop: List every variance found during the comparison.
Record each as an exception with the underwriter approval reference.
Done when every variance carries an approval reference.
verify: Re-read the exception list before issuance proceeds.
Pass when no unexplained variance remains against the bound quote.

generic.Defined scope/population: Requested mid-term changes affecting exposure, coverage or eligibility on in-force policies.
generic.In-scope period: Change requests raised in the current endorsement intake period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change type, added exposures, eligibility decision and rationale populated on the endorsement transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of eligibility decisions equals the count of change requests routed for assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Eligibility file note with assessor name and decision date on the endorsement transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referral triggers logged with the underwriter decision and its date.
generic.Test population: All change requests assessed for eligibility in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every assessed change carries a documented eligibility decision with rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Refer to an underwriter where a documented referral trigger is crossed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision recorded on the transaction and no ineligible exposure endorsed without referral approval.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement transaction file note in the administration system and the underwriting workstation record.

steps.title: Open the endorsement request on the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the change request and read the requested change and its effective date.
Identify the exposures the change adds, removes or alters.
Done when the requested change and affected exposures are identified.
verify: Compare the identified exposures to the request text.
Pass when every requested exposure change is identified.

steps.title: Check the change against current appetite and eligibility rules
sop: Read the current underwriting appetite and eligibility rules for the product.
Compare the requested change against those rules.
Done when the change is assessed against appetite and eligibility.
verify: Re-read the rule version used for the assessment.
Pass when the assessment used the current appetite and eligibility rules.

steps.title: Run added exposures through the eligibility screens
sop: Enter added locations, vehicles, drivers or insureds into the eligibility screens.
Read the screen result for each added exposure.
Done when every added exposure has an eligibility screen result.
verify: Recount the screened exposures against the requested additions.
Pass when every added exposure has been screened.

steps.title: Check for class, territory or no-write restrictions on the account
sop: Read any class, territory or no-write restriction flags on the account.
Compare the requested change against each restriction.
Done when the change has been checked against all account restrictions.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items routed below the matrix requirement logged and rerouted with the correction noted.
generic.Test population: All endorsement work items routed in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No change is processed at an authority level below the matrix requirement.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the next authority level and record the escalation on the work item.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Routing decision records the required authority level and the matrix row relied on.
generic.Evidence location: Work item routing record in the workflow tool and the authority matrix on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Read the change type and premium impact from the work item
sop: Open the endorsement work item and read the change type code.
Read the estimated or rated premium impact for the change.
Done when change type and premium impact are established.
verify: Compare both values to the validated change request.
Pass when change type and premium impact match the validated request.

steps.title: Look up the required authority level in the authority matrix
sop: Open the authority matrix on the underwriting workstation.
Find the row matching the change type and premium impact band.
Done when the required authority level is identified.
verify: Re-read the matrix row identified.
Pass when the identified row matches the change type and premium band.

steps.title: Route administrative changes to service processing
sop: Identify changes that are non-material administrative updates.
Route those items to the service processing queue.
Done when administrative changes are routed to service processing.
verify: Read the destination queue on each routed item.
Pass when non-material administrative changes sit in the service queue.

steps.title: Route coverage changes to underwriting
sop: Identify changes altering coverage, limits or exposure.
Route those items to the underwriting queue.
Done when coverage changes are routed to underwriting.
verify: Read the destination queue on each coverage change.
Pass when every coverage change sits in the underwriting queue.

steps.title: Escalate changes exceeding the servicing threshold
sop: Compare the change against the servicing authority threshold.
Escalate to the next authority level where the threshold is exceeded.
Done when every over-threshold change has been escalated.
verify: Re-read the authority level on escalated items.
Pass when no change sits at an authority level below the matrix requirement.

steps.title: Record the routing decision and confirm queue acknowledgment
sop: Record the routing decision and the matrix row relied upon on the work item.
Confirm the receiving queue acknowledged the item within the referral SLA.
Done when the decision is recorded and acknowledgment confirmed.
verify: Re-read the acknowledgment timestamp on the work item.
Pass when the receiving queue acknowledged within the referral SLA.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts for policies carrying a bound endorsement premium adjustment.
generic.In-scope period: From the endorsement effective date to the end of the current policy term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Adjustment amount, effective date, pay plan and revised instalment schedule populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of revised instalments equals prior balance plus the endorsement adjustment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Posting record with adjustment amount and posting timestamp on the billing account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Suspense items created by the posting logged and cleared with the resolution noted.
generic.Test population: All endorsement adjustments posted to billing in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No premium adjustment is left unapplied in billing suspense after the posting run.
generic.Exception handling path: Clear the suspense item and repost the adjustment to the correct account and term.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Billing account reflects the adjustment with a re-spread instalment schedule.
generic.Evidence location: Billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter and the endorsement transaction in the administration system.

steps.title: Post the premium adjustment to the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Open the billing account for the policy in BillingCenter.
Post the endorsement adjustment with the endorsement effective date.
Done when the adjustment is posted with the correct effective date.
verify: Read the posted adjustment date and amount.
Pass when the posted adjustment matches the rated endorsement amount and date.

steps.title: Confirm the instalment schedule re-spreads across remaining instalments
sop: Open the instalment schedule after the posting.
Confirm the adjustment is spread across the instalments remaining under the pay plan.
Done when the re-spread schedule has been reviewed.
