verify: Sum the revised instalments and compare to the expected balance.
Pass when the instalments sum to prior balance plus the adjustment.

steps.title: Apply a return premium as credit or refund per the account election
sop: Read the account election for return premium handling.
Apply the return as a credit or a refund but not both.
Done when the return premium is applied on the elected basis.
verify: Re-read the account transactions for duplicate handling.
Pass when the return premium appears once on the elected basis.

steps.title: Verify the revised amount due and next due date
sop: Read the amount due and next due date on the billing summary screen.
Compare both to the revised instalment schedule.
Done when amount due and next due date have been compared.
verify: Re-read the summary after any correction.
Pass when the summary agrees with the revised instalment schedule.

steps.title: Check for orphan suspense items created by the posting
sop: Filter the suspense report to the policy and billing account.
Investigate any item created by the endorsement posting.
Done when every suspense item for the account has been reviewed.
verify: Re-run the suspense filter after clearing.
Pass when no endorsement adjustment remains in billing suspense.

steps.title: Reconcile the billing account to the endorsed policy premium
sop: Read the total billed premium for the term on the billing account.
Compare it to the endorsed in-force premium on the policy.
Done when the two figures have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any adjustment.
Pass when billed premium equals the endorsed in-force premium.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policy records requiring update from a bound endorsement transaction.
generic.In-scope period: The current policy term from the endorsement effective date onward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage values, forms schedule, exposure schedules and version number populated on the in-force record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-force premium equals pre-change premium plus the endorsement adjustment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Prior policy version retained in history alongside the incremented current version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exposure additions or deletions not reflected logged as defects with the correction.
generic.Test population: All in-force records updated by an endorsement in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No prior policy version is overwritten or removed from history.
generic.Exception handling path: Roll back the commit and reapply the endorsement rather than editing the in-force record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: In-force record shows endorsed values with an incremented version number.
generic.Evidence location: In-force policy view and policy version history in Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Commit the endorsement in PolicyCenter so the in-force view updates
sop: Commit the bound endorsement to the in-force policy.
Open the in-force policy view and read the coverage values.
Done when the in-force view shows the endorsed coverage values.
verify: Compare in-force coverage values to the endorsement transaction.
Pass when the in-force values equal the endorsed values.

steps.title: Confirm the policy version number incremented
sop: Read the policy version number on the in-force record.
Compare it to the version before the endorsement.
Done when the version increment has been confirmed.
verify: Re-read the version number after the commit.
Pass when the version number is one higher than before the endorsement.

steps.title: Check the prior version is retained in history
sop: Open the policy version history in PolicyCenter.
Locate and open the version preceding the endorsement.
Done when the prior version is confirmed retrievable.
verify: Open the prior version and read its coverage values.
Pass when the prior version opens with its original values intact.

steps.title: Confirm the forms schedule includes the endorsement form
sop: Open the forms schedule on the in-force record.
Locate the endorsement form number added by this endorsement.
Done when the endorsement form is confirmed on the schedule.
verify: Re-read the schedule after the commit.
Pass when the endorsement form appears on the in-force forms schedule.

steps.title: Verify exposure schedules reflect additions and deletions
sop: Open the location, vehicle or life schedules affected by the endorsement.
Compare each entry against the approved change list.
Done when every affected schedule has been compared.
verify: Recount schedule entries against the approved change.
Pass when the schedules reflect every addition and deletion made.

steps.title: Reconcile in-force premium to pre-change premium plus adjustment
sop: Read the in-force premium on the policy summary.
Compare it to the pre-change premium plus the rated adjustment.
Done when the reconciliation has been performed.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any correction.
Pass when in-force premium equals pre-change premium plus the adjustment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Logged endorsement requests awaiting validation against the in-force policy record.
generic.In-scope period: The current policy term containing the requested effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Affected coverage part, requested effective date and required authority recorded on the request.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of validated requests equals the count of endorsement work items at intake.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation note with validator name and date held on the endorsement work item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests contradicting policy data returned to the requestor with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests validated in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement proceeds with an effective date outside the policy term.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the request to the requestor rather than assuming intent where data contradicts.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation note records affected coverage, effective date and required authority.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement work item in the workflow tool and the policy record in the administration system.

steps.title: Open the policy and confirm it is in force at the requested date
sop: Open the policy in the administration system and read its status.
Confirm it is not cancelled, lapsed or expired at the requested effective date.
Done when the in-force status at the requested date is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the policy status and term dates.
Pass when the policy is in force at the requested effective date.

steps.title: Identify the coverage part or schedule the change touches
sop: Read the requested change and map it to a coverage part or schedule.
Note the affected coverage on the endorsement request.
Done when the affected coverage part is identified and noted.
verify: Compare the noted coverage to the request wording.
Pass when the noted coverage part matches the requested change.

steps.title: Check the requested effective date falls inside the policy term
sop: Read the policy effective and expiration dates.
Compare the requested effective date against that range.
Done when the date has been compared to the term.
verify: Re-read the dates after any correction.
Pass when the requested effective date falls inside the policy term.

steps.title: Determine the binding authority required for the change
sop: Read the change type and estimated premium impact.
Determine the required binding authority from the authority rules.
Done when the required authority level is determined.
verify: Re-read the authority rule relied upon.
Pass when the recorded authority level matches the change type and impact.

steps.title: Return contradicted requests to the requestor
sop: Identify requests where policy data contradicts the stated change.
Return the request with the contradiction stated rather than assuming intent.
Done when every contradicted request is returned.
verify: Re-read the returned request log.
Pass when no contradicted request was processed on an assumption.

steps.title: Record the validation note on the endorsement work item
sop: Write the affected coverage, effective date and required authority into the note.
Record the validator name and date on the note.
Done when the validation note is saved on the work item.
verify: Reopen the work item and read the validation note.
Pass when the note records coverage, effective date and required authority.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies in the renewal window requiring renewal rating for the upcoming term.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term beginning at the renewal effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate book version, tier or experience factor and refreshed exposures populated on the rating input.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of policies rated equals the count of renewal candidates in the window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal rating output retained with rate book version and rating run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rate changes above the notice threshold referred to underwriting with the outcome logged.
generic.Test population: All renewals rated in the sample renewal month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every renewal is rated on the filed rate book effective at the renewal date.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-rate on the correct rate book and refer threshold breaches to underwriting before offer.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal premium rated on the correct rate book with the rate change recorded on the file.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal rating output in the administration system and the file note on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Select the rate book effective at the renewal effective date
sop: Read the renewal effective date from the renewal work item.
Select the filed rate book approved and effective at that date.
Done when the correct rate book version is selected.
verify: Compare the selected version to the filed rate register.
Pass when the rate book is filed and effective at the renewal date.

steps.title: Run renewal rating in the policy administration system
sop: Submit the renewal term to the rating engine with refreshed exposures.
Read the returned renewal premium by coverage.
Done when the renewal rating run returns a premium.
verify: Check the run completed without rating errors.
Pass when the renewal rating run completes cleanly.

steps.title: Confirm the carrier rate revision flowed through
sop: Compare the renewal rate factor to the expiring term rate factor.
Confirm any carrier rate revision is reflected in the difference.
Done when the rate factor comparison is complete.
verify: Re-read the rate revision reference on the output.
Pass when the applied factor reflects the current rate revision.

steps.title: Check tier and experience re-evaluation applied
sop: Read the tier, experience-mod or credit-tier values used in rating.
Confirm re-evaluation ran where the product rules require it.
Done when the re-evaluation status has been confirmed.
verify: Compare the values used to the current evaluation record.
Pass when the rating used current tier and experience values.

steps.title: Record the rate change percentage against expiring premium
sop: Compare renewal premium to expiring premium and compute the change percentage.
Record the percentage on the renewal file.
Done when the rate change percentage is recorded.
verify: Recompute the percentage from the two premiums.
Pass when the recorded percentage matches the computed change.

steps.title: Refer rate changes above the notice threshold to underwriting
sop: Compare the rate change percentage to the notice threshold.
Refer to underwriting before the offer where the threshold is exceeded.
Done when every threshold breach has been referred.
verify: Re-read the referral outcome on the renewal file.
Pass when no offer went out on a threshold breach without a referral.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal candidates requiring an underwriting review and retention action decision.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals reviewed within the current renewal review cycle for the expiring month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Refreshed loss history, exposure updates, underwriting action and reviewer name populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of completed reviews equals the count of renewal candidates assigned for review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal review note with reviewer name and review date filed on the renewal file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retention concessions logged with the approving authority and the rationale.
generic.Test population: All renewal reviews completed in the sample cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every renewal review is filed with an underwriting action and an identified reviewer.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the renewal to review where conditions were not carried onto the renewal terms.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal conditions attached to the renewal terms and the review note filed.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal review note on the underwriting workstation and the renewal terms in the administration system.

steps.title: Open the renewal review screen on the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the renewal candidate and its review screen.
Confirm loss history and exposure updates have been refreshed.
Done when the review screen shows refreshed data.
verify: Read the data as-of date on the review screen.
Pass when the loss and exposure data are refreshed for the review.

steps.title: Select the underwriting action for the renewal
sop: Choose renew as is, renew with conditions, refer or non-renew.
Record the rationale for the selected action.
Done when the underwriting action and rationale are recorded.
verify: Re-read the action and rationale on the review.
Pass when the review records an action with a stated rationale.

steps.title: Attach renewal conditions to the renewal terms
sop: List the conditions such as inspection, deductible increase or exclusion.
Attach each condition to the renewal terms in the administration system.
Done when every condition is attached to the renewal terms.
verify: Compare the renewal terms conditions to the review note.
Pass when every condition on the review appears on the renewal terms.

steps.title: Record retention actions on at-risk accounts
sop: Identify at-risk accounts flagged for retention action.
Record the rate concession or coverage restructure with its approval.
Done when every retention action carries a recorded approval.
verify: Re-read the approval reference on each retention action.
Pass when no retention concession is recorded without an approval.

steps.title: File the completed renewal review note
sop: Write the review conclusion into the renewal review note.
Record the reviewing underwriter name and the review date.
Done when the note is filed with reviewer name and date.
verify: Reopen the renewal file and read the note.
Pass when the note is filed with the underwriting action and reviewer identified.

steps.title: Confirm conditions carried onto the issued renewal
sop: Compare the issued renewal terms against the review conditions.
Return the renewal for correction where a condition is missing.
Done when the comparison is complete and gaps returned.
verify: Re-compare after any correction.
Pass when no renewal is issued with a review condition missing.

generic.Defined scope/population: Expiring-term declarations, forms and correspondence for policies that have renewed.
generic.In-scope period: Documents belonging to the expiring policy term being archived.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, term dates, document type and retention class populated on each archived record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of archived documents equals the count on the expiring-term document list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived records retained with term dates and the archive run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents that failed to archive logged with the reprocessing outcome.
generic.Test population: All expiring-term document sets archived in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No prior-term document is deleted ahead of its retention expiry.
generic.Exception handling path: Reprocess the failed archive move and hold the document as live until it succeeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prior-term documents present in the archive store and retrievable by policy and term.
generic.Evidence location: Archive store records in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the expiring policy term.

steps.title: List the expiring-term documents on the policy document list
sop: Filter the policy document list to the expiring term.
Export the list of declarations, forms and correspondence for that term.
Done when the expiring-term document list is exported.
verify: Compare the export count to the document list count.
Pass when the export contains every expiring-term document.

steps.title: Move the expiring-term documents to the archive store
sop: Run the archive move for the expiring term in OpenText.
Confirm each document lands in the archive store.
Done when every listed document is moved to archive.
verify: Recount archived records against the exported list.
Pass when the archived count equals the exported list count.

steps.title: Confirm archived documents remain indexed to policy and term
sop: Open a sample of archived records and read their index fields.
Confirm policy number and the expiring term dates are intact.
Done when the index fields have been checked on the sample.
verify: Search the archive by policy number and term.
Pass when the search returns the archived documents for that term.

steps.title: Apply the statutory retention class for the expiring term
sop: Set the retention class on the archived set to the expiring-term statutory class.
Confirm the calculated retention expiry date.
Done when retention class and expiry are set on the archived set.
verify: Re-read the retention fields on the archived records.
Pass when the retention class is the expiring-term class and not the active class.

steps.title: Test retrieval of an archived document within the SLA
sop: Request retrieval of a sample archived document from the policy document list.
Time the retrieval against the retrieval SLA.
Done when the retrieval test is completed and timed.
verify: Repeat the retrieval on a second sampled document.
Pass when archived documents are retrievable within the retrieval SLA.

steps.title: Confirm no prior-term document remains live on the new term
sop: Filter the new-term document list for documents carrying expiring-term dates.
Move any stray document to the archive set.
Done when no expiring-term document remains on the new term.
verify: Re-run the new-term filter after the move.
Pass when no prior-term document is attached to the new term as live.

generic.Defined scope/population: Accepted renewal offers awaiting the bind job on the renewal term.
generic.In-scope period: Renewal terms with effective dates in the current renewal binding window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Renewal acceptance, binding user authority, subjectivities and term dates populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of renewal terms bound equals the count of renewal acceptances on file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bind transaction retained with binding user, authority reference and bind timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open renewal subjectivities logged with due dates and their clearance outcome.
generic.Test population: All renewals bound in the sample renewal window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal is bound by a user outside the binding authority matrix.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold the bind and escalate to an authorised binder where authority is insufficient.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal term bound and chained to the expiring term in policy history.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal transaction in Guidewire PolicyCenter and the renewal work item in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal acceptance is on file
sop: Open the renewal work item and locate the recorded acceptance.
Confirm the acceptance document is attached and dated.
Done when the acceptance is confirmed on file.
verify: Open the acceptance attachment.
Pass when a dated renewal acceptance is on file before bind.

steps.title: Check the binding user authority against the matrix
sop: Read the renewal premium and limits from the renewal terms.
Compare them to the binding user authority in the matrix.
Done when the authority comparison is complete.
verify: Re-read the matrix row relied upon.
Pass when the binding user authority covers the renewal premium and limits.

steps.title: Run the bind job on the renewal term in PolicyCenter
sop: Execute the bind job from the renewal transaction.
Confirm a new term is created with the renewal effective date.
Done when the renewal term is bound.
verify: Read the term dates on the bound renewal.
Pass when the new term carries the renewal effective date.

steps.title: Verify renewal subjectivities are cleared or recorded as open items
sop: List the renewal subjectivities from the renewal terms.
Clear each or record it as an open item with a due date.
Done when every subjectivity is cleared or recorded.
verify: Recount open items against the subjectivity list.
Pass when every subjectivity is cleared or has an open item with a due date.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal term links to the expiring term
sop: Open the policy history chain after the bind.
Confirm the renewal term references the expiring term.
Done when the chain link is confirmed.
verify: Navigate from the renewal term back to the expiring term.
Pass when the renewal term is chained to the expiring term in history.

steps.title: Record the bind outcome on the renewal work item
sop: Record the bind date, binding user and authority reference on the work item.
Attach the bound renewal transaction reference.
Done when the bind outcome is recorded on the work item.
verify: Reopen the work item and read the bind block.
Pass when bind date, user and authority reference are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal work items whose renewal outcome has been completed in the administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Renewal work items completed within the current renewal notice-period cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome closure code, completion date and attached renewal declarations populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of closed renewal items equals the count of renewal candidates resolved in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal declarations attached to the work item with the closure timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items closed with an unbound renewal logged and reopened with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All renewal work items closed in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal work item is closed while the renewal remains unbound.
generic.Exception handling path: Reopen the item and complete the bind or non-renewal before closing again.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Outcome code recorded with renewal documents attached and billing transitioned.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal work item in the workflow tool and the renewal transaction in the administration system.

steps.title: Open the renewal work item in the workflow tool
sop: Locate the renewal work item for the policy and renewal term.
Confirm it is the active renewal case.
Done when the correct renewal work item is open.
verify: Compare the policy and term on the item to the renewal transaction.
Pass when the item references the renewal being closed.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal is bound and documents issued
sop: Read the renewal transaction status in the administration system.
Confirm renewal documents were generated and despatched.
Done when bind status and document issue are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the renewal status before closing.
Pass when the renewal is bound and its documents are issued.

steps.title: Confirm billing has transitioned to the renewal term
sop: Open the billing account and read the active schedule term.
Confirm the renewal-term schedule is open.
Done when the billing transition is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the billing schedule term.
Pass when the billing account shows the renewal-term schedule.

steps.title: Set the closure code to the renewal outcome
sop: Select renewed, non-renewed, lapsed or cancelled at renewal as the closure code.
Do not accept the system default code.
Done when the closure code reflects the actual outcome.
verify: Re-read the closure code on the closed item.
Pass when the code matches the renewal outcome recorded.

steps.title: Record the completion date against the notice-period milestone
sop: Read the renewal notice-period milestone on the work item.
Record the completion date and the variance to the milestone.
Done when completion date and variance are recorded.
verify: Re-read the milestone variance after saving.
Pass when the completion date and its variance are recorded.

steps.title: Attach the renewal declarations as the closing artefact
sop: Retrieve the renewal declarations from the administration system.
Attach them to the work item and confirm no open subtask remains.
Done when the declarations are attached and subtasks are clear.
verify: Open the attachment and refresh the subtask list.
Pass when the declarations open and no subtask remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewed policies whose renewal effective date has passed and require in-force confirmation.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term from its effective date forward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, term dates, limits, deductibles, forms and producer code populated on the renewal term.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of confirmed in-force renewals equals the count of renewals bound for the effective month.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: In-force confirmation with confirmation date recorded on the renewal work item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage gaps or mismatched terms logged with the corrective transaction applied.
generic.Test population: All renewal terms reaching their effective date in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero days of coverage gap between the expiring and renewal terms.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a corrective transaction to close any gap and record the correction on the work item.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New period shows In Force with continuous dates from the expiring term.
generic.Evidence location: Policy summary and in-force listing in Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Open the policy the day after the renewal effective date
sop: Open the policy in PolicyCenter on or after the renewal effective date.
Read the status shown for the new term.
Done when the new-term status has been read.
verify: Refresh the policy summary and re-read the status.
Pass when the status for the new term reads In Force.

steps.title: Check for a coverage gap between the terms
sop: Read the expiring term expiration date and the renewal effective date.
Compare them to confirm the dates are continuous.
Done when the two dates have been compared.
verify: Recompute the day difference between the terms.
Pass when there is no day of coverage gap between the terms.

steps.title: Verify renewal term limits, deductibles and forms
sop: Read limits, deductibles and forms on the renewal term.
Compare them to the accepted renewal offer.
Done when all three attribute groups have been compared.
verify: Re-compare after any correction.
Pass when the renewal term matches the accepted renewal offer.

steps.title: Confirm the policy appears on the in-force listing for the new term
sop: Run the in-force listing for the new term and producer code.
Locate the renewed policy on the listing.
Done when the policy is found on the new-term in-force listing.
verify: Compare the producer code shown to the policy record.
Pass when the policy lists under the correct producer code for the new term.

steps.title: Raise a corrective transaction for any gap or mismatch found
sop: Raise a corrective transaction where a gap or term mismatch exists.
Record the correction reference on the renewal work item.
Done when every finding has a corrective transaction raised.
verify: Re-read the term dates after the correction posts.
Pass when no gap or mismatch remains on the renewal term.

steps.title: Record the in-force confirmation on the renewal work item
sop: Enter the in-force confirmation and its date on the renewal work item.
Attach the in-force listing evidence to the item.
Done when the confirmation and evidence are recorded.
verify: Reopen the work item and read the confirmation entry.
Pass when the in-force confirmation and date are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal offers due for despatch to insureds and brokers of record for the renewal month.
generic.In-scope period: The statutory advance-notice window counted back from the renewal effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Despatch date, notice days required, recipient addresses and delivery preference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of offers despatched equals the count of renewal offers generated for the month.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Despatch date and proof of mailing recorded against the renewal transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Offers at risk of missing the notice window logged and escalated before despatch.
generic.Test population: All renewal offers despatched in the sample renewal month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal offer is despatched later than the state advance-notice requirement.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate late offers and issue the conditional renewal or extension the state requires.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Despatch date falls within the statutory advance-notice window with proof on file.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal transaction delivery record and the despatch log in the CRM.

steps.title: Look up the statutory advance-notice days for the risk state and line
sop: Read the risk state, line of business and the premium or coverage change.
Look up the advance-notice days required for that combination.
Done when the required notice days are established.
verify: Re-read the notice requirement source used.
Pass when the notice days recorded match the state requirement for the line.

steps.title: Count back from the renewal effective date to the latest despatch date
sop: Subtract the required notice days from the renewal effective date.
Record the latest permissible despatch date on the renewal transaction.
Done when the latest despatch date is recorded.
verify: Recompute the date from the effective date and notice days.
Pass when the recorded despatch deadline matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Retrieve the renewal offer package from OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Retrieve the released renewal offer indexed to the renewal term.
Confirm it is the version approved after the renewal review.
Done when the released renewal offer is retrieved.
verify: Compare the offer version to the renewal transaction.
Pass when the retrieved offer is the released version for the renewal.

steps.title: Include the conditional-renewal notice where required
sop: Check whether the renewal carries a material increase or coverage reduction.
Add the required conditional-renewal notice where it does.
Done when the conditional-renewal check is completed.
verify: Re-read the package contents for affected renewals.
Pass when every material change carries the required conditional-renewal notice.

steps.title: Despatch the offer to insured and broker on the delivery preference
sop: Read the delivery preference from the policy record.
Despatch the offer to both the insured and the broker of record on that channel.
Done when both despatches have been made.
verify: Read the despatch records for both recipients.
Pass when both insured and broker despatches exist for the offer.

steps.title: Record the despatch date and proof of mailing on the renewal transaction
sop: Enter the despatch date and channel on the renewal transaction.
Attach the proof of mailing or send confirmation.
Done when despatch date and proof are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded despatch date to the notice deadline.
Pass when the despatch date falls inside the statutory notice window.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies expiring in the target renewal month eligible for the renewal candidate report.
generic.In-scope period: The target renewal month defined by policy expiration dates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expiring premium, loss ratio, underwriter assignment and run date populated on each report row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report record count reconciles to the count of policies in the renewal window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report retained with the run date and the selection parameters used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cancelled, non-renewed or run-off policies excluded and the exclusions logged.
generic.Test population: All renewal candidate reports produced in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No cancelled or non-renewed policy appears on the candidate list.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-run the report with corrected exclusions and reissue to the receiving queues.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report produced with record count reconciled to the renewal window population.
generic.Evidence location: Report output in the administration system and the distribution record in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Run the renewal candidate report for the target month
sop: Set the report parameters to the target renewal month expiration dates.
Run the report in the policy administration system.
Done when the report has produced output for the month.
verify: Read the parameters recorded on the report header.
Pass when the report parameters match the target renewal month.

steps.title: Reconcile the report record count to the renewal window
sop: Count the policies expiring in the window from the policy listing.
Compare that count to the report record count.
Done when both counts have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any re-run.
Pass when the report count reconciles to the renewal window count.

steps.title: Check the report carries premium, loss ratio and underwriter
sop: Read expiring premium, loss ratio and underwriter assignment on sampled rows.
Flag rows with any of the three blank.
Done when the three fields have been checked on the sample.
verify: Re-check the flagged rows after correction.
Pass when every row carries premium, loss ratio and underwriter.

steps.title: Exclude cancelled, non-renewed and run-off policies
sop: Filter the report for policies flagged cancelled, non-renewed or in run-off.
Remove those rows and log the exclusions.
Done when every excluded policy has been removed and logged.
verify: Re-run the exclusion filter on the final report.
Pass when no cancelled or non-renewed policy remains on the list.

steps.title: Distribute the report to underwriting and servicing queues
sop: Send the report to the assigned underwriting and servicing queues.
Include the run date on the distributed report.
Done when the report has been distributed with its run date.
verify: Read the distribution record in the workflow tool.
Pass when both queues received the report with the run date shown.

steps.title: Record the report run and distribution on the renewal cycle log
sop: Record the run date, record count and recipients on the renewal cycle log.
Attach the report output to the log entry.
Done when the run is recorded on the cycle log.
verify: Reopen the cycle log entry.
Pass when the run date, count and recipients are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound renewal transactions requiring renewal declarations and updated policy documents.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term using form editions effective at the renewal effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Renewal term dates, premium, limits and forms schedule populated on the declarations.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Generated document count matches the renewal composition manifest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated set attached to the renewal transaction with template version and run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents showing expiring-term values logged and regenerated from the bound renewal.
generic.Test population: All renewal document generations run in the sample renewal month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal declarations carry expiring-term dates or premium.
generic.Exception handling path: Discard the output and regenerate from the bound renewal transaction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Declarations generated from the bound renewal and attached to the transaction.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal transaction document list and the stored set in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Generate the declarations from the bound renewal transaction
sop: Run document generation from the bound renewal transaction.
Do not edit or copy the expiring-term declarations.
Done when the renewal declarations are generated from the transaction.
verify: Read the source transaction on the generation log.
Pass when the source is the bound renewal transaction.

steps.title: Confirm term dates, premium and limits on the declarations
sop: Read the term dates, premium and limits on the generated declarations.
Compare each to the bound renewal record.
Done when all three have been compared.
verify: Re-compare after any regeneration.
Pass when declarations dates, premium and limits match the bound renewal.

steps.title: Check the forms schedule reflects renewal-term editions
sop: Compare the forms schedule editions against those effective at the renewal date.
Update any form whose edition changed for the renewal term.
Done when every form edition has been checked.
verify: Re-read the schedule after any update.
Pass when the schedule carries the editions effective at the renewal date.

steps.title: Include state notices required to accompany a renewal
sop: List the renewal notices required in the risk state.
Confirm each is included in the generated set.
Done when every required renewal notice is confirmed present.
verify: Re-check the notice list after regeneration.
Pass when no required renewal notice is missing.

steps.title: Scan the generated set for unresolved placeholders
sop: Search the generated documents for placeholder markers.
Reject and regenerate any document with an unresolved placeholder.
Done when every document has been scanned.
verify: Re-scan the regenerated documents.
Pass when no generated renewal document contains a placeholder.

steps.title: Attach the generated set to the renewal transaction
sop: Attach the declarations and updated documents to the renewal transaction.
Confirm each appears with the correct document type.
Done when the set is attached to the renewal transaction.
verify: Open the renewal document list.
Pass when the generated set is attached with correct document types.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal candidates with a completed underwriting review awaiting an offer document.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals due for offer release ahead of the statutory notice window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Renewal premium, expiring premium, coverage changes, conditions and validity date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of offers produced equals the count of renewals approved for offer at review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Offer document retained with its production date and the review note reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Offers omitting a review condition logged and reissued with the condition included.
generic.Test population: All renewal offers produced in the sample renewal month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No offer is released omitting an underwriting condition recorded at review.
generic.Exception handling path: Withdraw and reissue the offer where a condition or change was omitted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Offer states renewal premium, expiring premium and every coverage change.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal offer document in the administration system and the review note on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Retrieve the renewal review note and rated renewal premium
sop: Open the renewal review note on the underwriting workstation.
Read the approved action, conditions and the rated renewal premium.
Done when the review note and premium are in hand.
verify: Compare the premium to the renewal rating output.
Pass when the premium used equals the rated renewal premium.

steps.title: Build the offer showing renewal, expiring and change amounts
sop: State the renewal premium, the expiring premium and the change amount on the offer.
Confirm the change amount equals the difference between the two.
Done when all three amounts appear on the offer.
verify: Recompute the change amount from the two premiums.
Pass when the stated change equals the computed difference.

steps.title: List every coverage term change from the expiring term
sop: Compare renewal terms to expiring terms coverage by coverage.
List each difference explicitly on the offer.
Done when every coverage change is listed on the offer.
verify: Re-compare the term differences to the offer list.
Pass when every coverage change appears on the offer.

steps.title: State underwriting conditions and their deadlines on the offer
sop: Read the conditions recorded on the renewal review note.
State each condition and its deadline on the face of the offer.
Done when every condition and deadline appears on the offer.
verify: Compare the offer conditions to the review note.
Pass when no condition from the review is missing from the offer.

steps.title: Confirm the offer validity date allows time to respond
sop: Set the offer validity date ahead of the renewal effective date.
Confirm the insured has the standard response window.
Done when the validity date is set with the standard response window.
verify: Recompute the days between offer despatch and effective date.
Pass when the response window meets the standard before the effective date.

steps.title: Review the offer against the renewal review note before release
sop: Compare the finished offer against the review note point by point.
Correct any omission before the offer is released.
Done when the offer has been reviewed against the note.
verify: Re-read the offer after any correction.
Pass when the released offer reflects the renewal review note in full.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policies whose expiration date falls in the target renewal identification window.
generic.In-scope period: Typically the 90-day window ahead of policy expiration dates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expiration date, do-not-renew flag, run-off flag and SLA anchor populated on each selection.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of work items created equals the count of policies selected in the window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Identification job output retained with its run date and selection parameters.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies with pending cancellations or run-off flags excluded and the exclusions logged.
generic.Test population: All policies entering the renewal window in the sample run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No policy passes its renewal window without a renewal or non-renewal work item.
generic.Exception handling path: Create the missing work item manually and log the identification gap for root cause.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A renewal work item exists for every policy entering the renewal window.
generic.Evidence location: Identification job output in the administration system and the work items in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Run the renewal identification job for the target window
sop: Set the job window to policies expiring in the target period.
Run the identification job in the administration system.
Done when the job has produced a selection list.
verify: Read the parameters on the job output.
Pass when the job window matches the intended renewal window.

steps.title: Confirm the selection uses expiration date and excludes pending cancellations
sop: Check the selection criteria used expiration date as the driver.
Confirm policies with a pending cancellation are excluded.
Done when the selection criteria have been confirmed.
verify: Sample the selection for a policy with a pending cancellation.
Pass when no pending-cancellation policy appears in the selection.

steps.title: Route do-not-renew and run-off policies to non-renewal
sop: Filter the selection for do-not-renew and run-off flags.
Route those policies to the non-renewal queue instead of renewals.
Done when every flagged policy has been routed to non-renewal.
verify: Re-run the flag filter on the renewal queue.
Pass when no do-not-renew or run-off policy sits in the renewal queue.

steps.title: Create a renewal work item for each selected policy
sop: Create a work item for each policy remaining in the selection.
Set the expiration date as the SLA anchor on each item.
Done when a work item exists for every selected policy.
verify: Read the SLA anchor on a sample of created items.
Pass when each item carries the policy expiration date as its anchor.

steps.title: Reconcile work items created to policies in the window
sop: Count the work items created for the run.
Compare to the count of policies selected in the window.
Done when the two counts have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any manual creation.
Pass when work item count equals the policy count in the window.

steps.title: Create missing work items and log the identification gap
sop: Identify policies in the window with no renewal or non-renewal item.
Create the missing item and log the gap for root cause review.
Done when every gap is closed and logged.
verify: Re-run the gap check after creation.
Pass when no policy in the window is left without a work item.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal terms requiring a first invoice or EFT pre-notification in the billing platform.
generic.In-scope period: The lead-day window before the renewal effective date for each renewal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Billed amount, due date, EFT account status and pre-note lead days populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Billed amount equals renewal premium plus applicable taxes and fees.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Invoice or draft-notice send date recorded on the billing account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Invalid or closed bank accounts logged and the draft suppressed until corrected.
generic.Test population: All renewal invoices and EFT notices issued in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No EFT draft is raised against a closed or invalid bank account on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Suppress the draft, contact the insured for banking details and reissue the notice.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice issued with a due date ahead of the renewal effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Billing account notice history in Guidewire BillingCenter.

steps.title: Generate the renewal invoice or EFT pre-notification in BillingCenter
sop: Open the renewal-term billing schedule in BillingCenter.
Generate the first invoice or EFT pre-notification for the renewal premium.
Done when the notice has been generated.
verify: Read the generated notice on the billing account.
Pass when the notice exists for the renewal term.

steps.title: Confirm the due date allows the required lead days
sop: Read the invoice due date and the renewal effective date.
Confirm the gap meets the required lead days.
Done when the lead-day check has been performed.
verify: Recompute the days between due date and effective date.
Pass when the due date is ahead of the renewal effective date by the lead days.

steps.title: Check the billed amount against renewal premium plus charges
sop: Read the billed amount on the notice.
Compare it to the renewal premium plus taxes and fees.
Done when the amounts have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any adjustment.
Pass when the billed amount equals renewal premium plus taxes and fees.

steps.title: Verify the EFT account is active before drafting
sop: Read the bank account status held on the billing account.
Suppress the draft where the account is closed or invalid.
Done when the account status has been checked.
verify: Re-read the account status before the draft run.
Pass when no draft is raised against a closed or invalid account.

steps.title: Confirm the EFT pre-note lead time is respected
sop: Read the pre-note send date and the first draft date.
Confirm the pre-note lead time has elapsed before drafting.
Done when the pre-note lead time has been confirmed.
verify: Recompute the days between pre-note and draft.
Pass when the pre-note lead time is respected before the first draft.

steps.title: Record the send date on the billing account
sop: Enter the invoice or draft-notice send date on the billing account.
Attach the notice copy to the account history.
Done when the send date and notice are recorded.
verify: Reopen the billing account notice history.
Pass when the send date and notice copy are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Coverage modifications requested at renewal for application to the renewal term.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term from the renewal effective date onward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requested changes, change effective date and revised premium populated on the renewal term.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of modifications applied equals the count captured on the renewal work item.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Endorsement transactions on the renewal term retained with their effective dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Modifications applied to the wrong term logged and reversed with the correction recorded.
generic.Test population: All renewal-term modifications processed in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal modification is applied to the expiring term in error.
generic.Exception handling path: Reverse the misapplied endorsement and reapply it to the renewal term.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Modifications applied to the renewal term through the endorsement workflow and re-rated.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal term transactions in the administration system and the renewal work item in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Capture the requested renewal-term changes on the work item
sop: Record each requested coverage change on the renewal work item before binding.
Note the source and requestor of each change.
Done when every requested change is captured on the work item.
verify: Compare the captured list to the source request.
Pass when every requested change appears on the work item.

steps.title: Process the changes through the endorsement workflow on the renewal term
sop: Open an endorsement transaction against the renewal term.
Apply the captured changes on that transaction only.
Done when the changes are applied on the renewal term transaction.
verify: Read the term the endorsement is attached to.
Pass when the endorsement sits on the renewal term and not the expiring term.

steps.title: Confirm the change effective date
sop: Set the change effective date to the renewal effective date by default.
Use a later date only where the requestor asked for one.
Done when the change effective date is set and recorded.
verify: Compare the effective date to the request.
Pass when the effective date is the renewal date or the later date requested.

steps.title: Re-rate the renewal after the modifications
sop: Submit the modified renewal term to the rating engine.
Read the revised renewal premium returned.
Done when the renewal has been re-rated after the modifications.
verify: Compare the revised premium to the declarations premium.
Pass when the declarations premium equals the re-rated renewal premium.

steps.title: Reissue the renewal declarations where changes land after the offer
sop: Identify modifications applied after the original offer despatch.
Regenerate and reissue the renewal declarations for those cases.
Done when affected declarations have been reissued.
verify: Read the despatch record for the reissued declarations.
Pass when reissued declarations were despatched for every late modification.

steps.title: Check no modification was applied to the expiring term
sop: List transactions posted to the expiring term during the renewal cycle.
Reverse any renewal modification applied there in error.
Done when the expiring term has been checked and any error reversed.
verify: Re-list expiring-term transactions after any reversal.
Pass when no renewal modification remains on the expiring term.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prior-term loss data, exposure values and rate revision factors for renewal candidates.
generic.In-scope period: Prior term through the current loss valuation date up to the renewal effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Paid and incurred losses, refreshed exposures, rate factors and data as-of date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pulled loss totals reconcile to the claims system totals for the account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Data extract retained on the renewal file with its as-of date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reconciliation differences to the claims system logged with the resolution.
generic.Test population: All renewal files with prior-term data pulled in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal is rated on loss data older than the required valuation cut-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-pull the data at the correct valuation date before rating proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loss and exposure data attached to the renewal file with an as-of date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal file on the underwriting workstation and the rating input in the administration system.

steps.title: Pull prior-term paid and incurred loss data
sop: Pull paid and incurred losses for the account through the current valuation date.
Record the valuation date on the extract.
Done when the loss data is pulled with its valuation date.
verify: Compare the valuation date to the required cut-off.
Pass when the loss data valuation date meets the required cut-off.

steps.title: Refresh exposure values for the renewal term
sop: Collect updated payroll, sales, vehicle counts or property values.
Enter the refreshed exposures on the renewal rating input.
Done when the exposure values are refreshed for the renewal term.
verify: Compare refreshed exposures to the source returned by the insured.
Pass when the rating input carries the refreshed exposure values.

steps.title: Retrieve the applicable rate revision factors
sop: Identify rate revisions effective between the expiring and renewal effective dates.
Retrieve the factors applying to the renewal term.
Done when the applicable rate revision factors are retrieved.
verify: Compare the retrieved factors to the filed rate revisions.
Pass when the factors retrieved match the filed revisions for the period.

steps.title: Reconcile pulled loss data to claims system totals
sop: Compare the pulled paid and incurred totals to the claims system totals.
Investigate and log any difference before the data feeds rating.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and differences logged.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any correction.
Pass when the pulled totals reconcile to the claims system totals.

steps.title: Attach the data extract to the renewal file
sop: Attach the loss and exposure extract to the renewal file.
Confirm the extract is readable and complete.
Done when the extract is attached to the renewal file.
verify: Open the attachment from the renewal file.
Pass when the attached extract opens with loss and exposure data intact.

steps.title: Record the data as-of date on the renewal file
sop: Enter the as-of date for the loss and exposure data on the renewal file.
Confirm the rating basis can be traced from that date.
Done when the as-of date is recorded on the file.
verify: Reopen the renewal file and read the as-of date.
Pass when the as-of date is retrievable and traceable to the rating basis.

generic.Defined scope/population: Broker and insured responses to renewal offers on open renewal work items.
generic.In-scope period: Responses received between offer despatch and the renewal effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Response type, response date, declination reason code and attachment populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged responses reconciles to the count of renewal offers despatched.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written acceptance, declination or counter-proposal attached with its received date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Renewals with no response near the effective date logged and chased with the outcome.
generic.Test population: All renewal offers awaiting a response in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal reaches its effective date with an unrecorded broker or insured response.
generic.Exception handling path: Chase the broker and escalate before the effective date rather than assuming acceptance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Response type, date and supporting correspondence recorded on the renewal work item.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal work item in the workflow tool and the contact record in the CRM.

steps.title: Log the response type against the renewal work item
sop: Read the response received and classify it as accepted, declined or counter-request.
Record the classification and the response date on the work item.
Done when the response type and date are recorded.
verify: Compare the classification to the response content.
Pass when the recorded type reflects the response received.

steps.title: Attach the written response to the renewal file
sop: Attach the acceptance, declination email or counter-proposal to the renewal file.
Confirm the attachment is legible and dated.
Done when the written response is attached to the file.
verify: Open the attachment from the renewal file.
Pass when the attached response opens and matches the logged type.

steps.title: Capture the structured declination reason code
sop: Ask the broker or insured for the reason where the renewal is declined.
Select the structured reason code from the controlled list.
Done when a structured declination reason is recorded.
verify: Re-read the reason code on declined renewals.
Pass when every declination carries a structured reason code.

steps.title: Route counter-requests back to underwriting
sop: Identify responses that propose different terms or premium.
Route those to underwriting rather than amending the offer at service level.
Done when every counter-request is routed to underwriting.
verify: Read the routing destination on counter-request items.
Pass when no counter-request was amended at service level.

steps.title: Chase renewals with no response near the effective date
sop: List renewals approaching their effective date with a blank response field.
Chase the broker or insured and record the chase on the work item.
Done when every unanswered renewal has a recorded chase.
verify: Re-run the blank-response list after the chase.
Pass when no renewal nears its effective date without a chase logged.

steps.title: Confirm no renewal passes its effective date without a response
sop: Run the exception report for renewals past effective date with no response.
Escalate each case and record the outcome.
Done when every exception has been escalated and recorded.
verify: Re-run the exception report after escalation.
Pass when no renewal past its effective date has a blank response field.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewals offered and renewed in the reporting period across products and producers.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period agreed with underwriting management for retention reporting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policies offered, policies renewed, declination reason codes and segment fields populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported policy counts reconcile to the renewal candidate report for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report retained with its period, run date and the delivery log entry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declinations without a reason code logged and chased before the report is finalised.
generic.Test population: All renewals in the reported period across the reported segments.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No declination is included in the reported population without a reason code.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold the reason-code gap as an exception line and correct at source before the next cycle.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Retention report delivered with counts reconciled to the renewal candidate report.
generic.Evidence location: Retention report output in the administration system and the delivery log for underwriting management.

steps.title: Compile renewals offered and renewals renewed for the period
sop: Extract the count of renewals offered and the count renewed for the period.
Compute retention as renewed divided by offered.
Done when the retention figure is computed for the period.
verify: Recompute retention from the extracted counts.
Pass when the reported retention equals the recomputed figure.

steps.title: Break retention down by segment, product and producer
sop: Split the population by segment, product and producer as the standard requires.
Compute retention for each breakdown.
Done when every required breakdown has a retention figure.
verify: Sum the breakdown populations back to the total.
Pass when the breakdowns sum to the total population.

steps.title: Summarise declination reason codes by premium lost
sop: Group declinations by reason code and sum the premium lost for each.
Flag the top reasons by premium lost in the summary.
Done when the reason-code summary is produced.
verify: Re-sum the premium lost across reason codes.
Pass when the summed premium lost equals the total declined premium.

steps.title: Check every declination carries a reason code
sop: Filter the declined population for blank reason codes.
Chase the missing codes before finalising the report.
Done when every declination in the population has a reason code.
verify: Re-run the blank-code filter on the final population.
Pass when no declination in the reported population lacks a reason code.

steps.title: Reconcile reported counts to the renewal candidate report
sop: Compare reported policy counts to the renewal candidate report for the period.
Investigate any difference before delivery.
Done when the counts have been reconciled.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any correction.
Pass when reported counts reconcile to the renewal candidate report.

steps.title: Deliver the report to underwriting management and log the delivery
sop: Send the report to underwriting management on the agreed cadence.
Log the delivery date and recipients.
Done when the report is delivered and logged.
verify: Reopen the delivery log entry.
Pass when the delivery date and recipients are retrievable for the period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts for renewed policies requiring transition from expiring to renewal term.
generic.In-scope period: From the expiring term close to the renewal-term schedule open date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pay plan, instalment count, due dates and EFT authorisation populated on the renewal schedule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-transition balance equals expiring balance plus renewal premium billed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transition posting retained on the billing account with its posting timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Stranded unapplied cash logged with the transfer or refund decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts transitioned to a renewal term in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No expiring-term unapplied cash is stranded outside the renewal billing schedule.
generic.Exception handling path: Transfer the unapplied cash to the renewal term or refund it on an explicit election.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal-term schedule open with the expiring balance carried correctly.
generic.Evidence location: Billing account schedules in Guidewire BillingCenter and the renewal transaction in the administration system.

steps.title: Close the expiring-term billing schedule in BillingCenter
sop: Open the billing account and locate the expiring-term schedule.
Close the schedule once the term has expired.
Done when the expiring-term schedule is closed.
verify: Read the expiring schedule status.
Pass when the expiring-term schedule shows closed.

steps.title: Open the renewal-term schedule on the same account
sop: Create the renewal-term schedule on the existing billing account.
Confirm the schedule covers the renewal term dates.
Done when the renewal-term schedule is open on the account.
verify: Read the schedule term dates.
Pass when the renewal schedule dates equal the renewal term dates.

steps.title: Transfer expiring-term credit or unapplied cash to the renewal term
sop: Identify any credit or unapplied cash on the expiring term.
Transfer it to the renewal term rather than refunding by default.
Done when every credit has been transferred or explicitly refunded.
verify: Re-read the unapplied cash position on the account.
Pass when no expiring-term unapplied cash sits outside the renewal schedule.

steps.title: Check the pay plan and instalment dates carried across
sop: Compare the renewal pay plan, instalment count and due dates to the insured election.
Reset the plan where the insured elected a change.
Done when the pay plan and dates have been checked against the election.
verify: Re-read the plan and due dates on the renewal schedule.
Pass when the plan and dates match the insured election.

steps.title: Verify recurring EFT or card authorisation for the renewal term
sop: Read the recurring authorisation status on the account.
Confirm it remains valid for the renewal term or re-authorise.
Done when the authorisation status is confirmed valid.
verify: Re-read the authorisation expiry against the renewal term dates.
Pass when the authorisation covers the renewal term.

steps.title: Reconcile the account balance after transition
sop: Read the account balance after the transition posting.
Compare it to the expiring balance plus renewal premium billed.
Done when the balance has been reconciled.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any adjustment.
Pass when the balance equals expiring balance plus renewal premium billed.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force records for renewed policies requiring update to the new policy period.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term from its effective date forward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Current term pointer, exposure schedules, named insureds and additional interests populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of additional interests on the renewal term equals the count on the expiring term.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal term record retained with the update timestamp and the expiring term marked Expired.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dropped interests or exposures logged and reinstated with the correction recorded.
generic.Test population: All renewed policies whose in-force records were updated in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No additional interest is dropped between the expiring and renewal terms.
generic.Exception handling path: Reattach the missing interest by endorsement and log the omission for root cause.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: In-force records show the renewal term as current with interests carried forward.
generic.Evidence location: Policy in-force record and term history in Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Confirm the in-force record points to the renewal term
sop: Open the policy in PolicyCenter and read the current term pointer.
Confirm it references the renewal term.
Done when the current term pointer has been read.
verify: Re-read the current term after refresh.
Pass when the in-force record points to the renewal term.

steps.title: Check exposure schedules carried forward to the new term
sop: Open the location, vehicle or life schedules on the renewal term.
Compare each against the expiring term schedules plus approved changes.
Done when every schedule has been compared.
verify: Recount schedule entries on both terms.
Pass when the renewal schedules equal the expiring schedules plus approved changes.

steps.title: Verify named insureds carried forward
sop: Read the named insured block on the renewal term.
Compare it to the expiring term named insureds.
Done when the named insured comparison is complete.
verify: Re-compare after any correction.
Pass when the renewal named insureds match the expiring term plus approved changes.

steps.title: Confirm additional interests remain attached with current details
sop: List mortgagees, loss payees and other interests on the renewal term.
Compare the list and their details to the expiring term.
Done when every interest has been compared.
verify: Recount interests on both terms.
Pass when no additional interest is dropped between the terms.

steps.title: Confirm the expiring term is marked Expired
sop: Read the status on the expiring term after the renewal takes effect.
Correct the status where it reads Cancelled instead of Expired.
Done when the expiring term status has been read and corrected if needed.
verify: Re-read the expiring term status.
Pass when the expiring term reads Expired and not Cancelled.

steps.title: Check downstream extracts picked up the renewal term
sop: Open the interface monitor after the next extract run.
Confirm the renewal term appears in the outbound extract.
Done when the extract has been checked for the renewal term.
verify: Re-run the interface filter for the policy.
Pass when the renewal term is present in the downstream extract.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policy files for cancelled policies whose return premium has settled.
generic.In-scope period: From the cancellation effective date through the statutory retention period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, cancellation date and retention class populated on the archived file.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of archived files equals the count of cancellations settled in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cancellation notice and proof of mailing archived with the archive run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts under legal hold excluded from archive and the hold logged.
generic.Test population: All cancelled policy files archived in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No cancelled file is archived while a legal hold is active on the account.
generic.Exception handling path: Suspend the archive move and retain the file live until the legal hold is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: File archived with retention measured from the cancellation effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Archive store record in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the cancelled policy.

steps.title: Confirm the return premium has settled before archiving
sop: Read the billing account balance for the cancelled term.
Confirm the return premium is disbursed or credited.
Done when the settlement status has been confirmed.
verify: Re-read the account balance before the archive move.
Pass when the return premium is settled on the cancelled term.

steps.title: Check for an active legal hold on the account
sop: Read the legal hold flag on the policy and the account.
Suspend the archive where a hold is active and log the hold.
Done when the legal hold status has been checked.
verify: Re-read the hold flag before the move executes.
Pass when no file under legal hold is moved to a restricted archive tier.

steps.title: Move the cancelled policy file to the archive store
sop: Run the archive move for the cancelled policy file in OpenText.
Confirm every document in the file lands in the archive store.
Done when the file is moved to archive.
verify: Recount archived documents against the policy document list.
Pass when the archived count equals the policy file count.

steps.title: Apply retention measured from the cancellation effective date
sop: Set the retention class using the cancellation effective date as the start.
Confirm the calculated expiry reflects that start date.
Done when the retention start and expiry are set.
verify: Re-read the retention fields on the archived file.
Pass when retention is measured from the cancellation date and not the issue date.

steps.title: Confirm the cancellation notice and proof of mailing are in the file
sop: Locate the cancellation notice and proof of mailing in the archived set.
Add either where it is missing before completing the archive.
Done when both artefacts are confirmed in the archived file.
verify: Retrieve both artefacts from the archive.
Pass when the notice and proof of mailing are both present.

steps.title: Test retrieval by policy number and insured name
sop: Search the archive by policy number and again by insured name.
Confirm the archived file returns on both searches.
Done when both retrieval tests have been run.
verify: Repeat the searches on a second archived file.
Pass when archived files are retrievable by policy number and insured name.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancelled policy terms requiring a return premium calculation on the cancellation basis.
generic.In-scope period: From the cancellation effective date to the original policy expiration date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cancellation type, earned premium, taxes and fees treatment populated on the transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: System-calculated return premium agrees with the manual recalculation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation basis and result recorded on the cancellation transaction with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences between system and manual calculation logged with the resolution.
generic.Test population: All return premium calculations performed in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No short-rate penalty is applied where the cancellation was carrier-initiated.
generic.Exception handling path: Recalculate on the correct basis and reissue the return premium figure before disbursement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Return premium calculated on the correct basis with the calculation recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation transaction in the administration system and the calculation record in the billing platform.

steps.title: Confirm the cancellation type before calculating
sop: Read the cancellation type recorded on the transaction.
Confirm it is flat, pro-rata or short-rate as classified.
Done when the cancellation basis is confirmed.
verify: Compare the basis to the classification record.
Pass when the calculation basis matches the recorded cancellation type.

steps.title: Apply the earned-premium calculation to the day
sop: Compute earned premium from the inception date to the cancellation effective date.
Use exact days rather than whole months.
Done when earned premium is computed to the day.
verify: Recompute the day count between the two dates.
Pass when the earned premium reflects the exact day count.

steps.title: Apply state rules to taxes, fees and surcharges
sop: Read the state rules for returning or retaining taxes, fees and surcharges.
Apply each charge line on its own rule rather than returning all.
Done when every charge line has been treated on its rule.
verify: Re-read the charge treatment against the state rule.
Pass when charges are returned or retained per the state rule.

steps.title: Check short-rate is not applied to a carrier-initiated cancellation
sop: Read whether the cancellation was carrier-initiated or insured-requested.
Remove any short-rate penalty on carrier-initiated cancellations.
Done when the short-rate check has been performed.
verify: Re-read the applied basis on carrier-initiated cases.
Pass when no short-rate penalty applies on a carrier-initiated cancellation.

steps.title: Compare the system figure against a manual recalculation
sop: Recalculate the return premium manually from written premium and the earned factor.
Compare the manual figure to the system-calculated return premium.
Done when both figures have been compared.
verify: Recompute the difference after any correction.
Pass when the manual and system return premium figures agree.

steps.title: Record the calculation basis and result on the transaction
sop: Record the cancellation basis, earned premium and return premium on the transaction.
Attach the calculation working to the transaction.
Done when basis and result are recorded with the working attached.
verify: Reopen the transaction and read the calculation block.
Pass when the basis, result and working are all retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Invoices, instalment notices and dunning letters queued for a cancelled policy term.
generic.In-scope period: Notices scheduled to despatch on or after the cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice status, void date and aging bucket populated on the billing account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of notices voided equals the count queued for the cancelled term.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Void action recorded on the billing account notes with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices that despatched after cancellation logged with the apology or recall action.
generic.Test population: All queued notices for cancelled terms in the sample print cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No premium notice despatches to the insured after the cancellation effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Recall the notice from the print run and notify the insured where it despatched.
