generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All queued notices voided before the next print run with the action logged.
generic.Evidence location: Billing account notice queue in Guidewire BillingCenter and the account notes.

steps.title: List queued notices for the cancelled term in BillingCenter
sop: Filter the notice queue to the cancelled policy and term.
List invoices, instalment notices and dunning letters pending.
Done when the queued notice list is produced.
verify: Compare the list count to the account notice schedule.
Pass when the list captures every pending notice for the term.

steps.title: Void or withdraw each queued notice
sop: Void or withdraw each notice on the list before the print run.
Record the void action against each notice.
Done when every queued notice is voided or withdrawn.
verify: Re-run the notice queue filter.
Pass when no notice for the cancelled term remains queued.

steps.title: Confirm no notice is scheduled after the cancellation effective date
sop: Check the forward notice schedule for the account.
Remove any schedule entry dated after the cancellation effective date.
Done when the forward schedule holds no post-cancellation notice.
verify: Re-read the forward notice schedule.
Pass when no notice is scheduled after the cancellation effective date.

steps.title: Clear or reduce the aging bucket to the earned balance
sop: Read the aging bucket for the cancelled policy.
Reduce it to the earned balance only or clear it where nothing is owed.
Done when the aging bucket reflects the earned balance.
verify: Re-read the aging position after adjustment.
Pass when the aging bucket shows only the earned balance.

steps.title: Suppress the account from the next collections extract
sop: Set the collections suppression flag where nothing further is owed.
Confirm the account is excluded from the next collections run.
Done when the suppression is applied or confirmed unnecessary.
verify: Check the account against the next collections extract.
Pass when a fully settled account does not appear on the collections extract.

steps.title: Record the notices cancelled on the billing account notes
sop: Record the notices voided, the count and the date on the account notes.
Attach the void confirmation where the system produces one.
Done when the void action is recorded on the account notes.
verify: Reopen the account notes.
Pass when the voided notices and date are retrievable from the notes.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellation requests requiring classification as flat, pro-rata or short-rate.
generic.In-scope period: Cancellations with effective dates in the current processing period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Initiating party, cancellation effective date, selected type and rule reference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of classified cancellations equals the count of validated cancellation triggers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Selected type and supporting rule recorded on the transaction with the decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short-rate selections in prohibiting states logged and reclassified.
generic.Test population: All cancellations classified in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No short-rate basis is used in a state where short-rate cancellation is prohibited.
generic.Exception handling path: Reclassify to pro-rata and recalculate the return premium before disbursement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cancellation type recorded with the state or policy rule supporting the basis.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation transaction in the administration system and the rule lookup on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Identify whether the cancellation is insured-requested or carrier-initiated
sop: Read the cancellation request record and its source trigger.
Record the initiating party on the transaction.
Done when the initiating party is identified and recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded party to the source trigger document.
Pass when the initiating party matches the source trigger.

steps.title: Apply flat cancellation only at inception with no coverage provided
sop: Compare the cancellation effective date to the inception date.
Select flat only where the dates are equal and no coverage was provided.
Done when the flat test has been applied.
verify: Re-read the dates on any flat cancellation.
Pass when flat is used only where effective date equals inception.

steps.title: Apply pro-rata for carrier-initiated or prohibiting states
sop: Check whether the carrier initiated the cancellation.
Check whether the state prohibits short-rate and select pro-rata where either applies.
Done when the pro-rata test has been applied.
verify: Re-read the state rule and the initiating party.
Pass when pro-rata is used for carrier-initiated and prohibiting-state cases.

steps.title: Apply short-rate only where permitted and insured-requested
sop: Confirm the cancellation is insured-requested.
Confirm state and policy terms permit short-rate before selecting it.
Done when the short-rate permission has been confirmed.
verify: Re-read the permission source for each short-rate case.
Pass when no short-rate basis is used in a prohibiting state.

steps.title: Record the selected type and the rule relied on
sop: Record the selected cancellation type on the transaction.
Record the state or policy rule reference supporting the selection.
Done when type and rule reference are recorded.
verify: Reopen the transaction and read both fields.
Pass when the type and its supporting rule are retrievable.

steps.title: Confirm the classification feeds the return premium calculation
sop: Open the return premium calculation and read the basis it used.
Confirm it matches the recorded classification.
Done when the calculation basis has been compared to the classification.
verify: Re-read the calculation basis after any reclassification.
Pass when the calculation basis equals the recorded cancellation type.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellation cases where policy, billing, notice and downstream steps are believed complete.
generic.In-scope period: Cancellations with effective dates reached in the current completion review period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy status, cancellation date, billing balance and notification acknowledgments populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of cases confirmed complete equals the count of cancellations processed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completion confirmation recorded on the work item with its completion date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases with outstanding return premium or notices logged and returned to processing.
generic.Test population: All cancellation cases reviewed for completion in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No cancellation is marked complete with an outstanding return premium unissued.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the case to processing until the outstanding step is finished.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Policy status, billing balance and notice proof all verified before completion.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation work item in the workflow tool and the policy and billing records.

steps.title: Confirm the policy status and cancellation effective date
sop: Open the policy and read the status and cancellation effective date.
Compare the date to the despatched cancellation notice.
Done when status and date have been read and compared.
verify: Re-read the status and date after any correction.
Pass when the status reads Cancelled with the notice effective date.

steps.title: Check the return premium is disbursed or credited
sop: Open the billing account and read the return premium disposition.
Confirm the balance is nil or earned premium only.
Done when the return premium disposition has been read.
verify: Re-read the account balance.
Pass when no outstanding return premium remains unissued.

steps.title: Verify the notice despatch and proof of mailing are on file
sop: Locate the cancellation notice and its proof of mailing.
Confirm both are indexed to the policy and the cancellation.
Done when both artefacts have been located.
verify: Retrieve both artefacts from the document repository.
Pass when the notice and proof of mailing are both retrievable.

steps.title: Confirm downstream notifications were acknowledged
sop: Open the interface log and read acknowledgments from claims, billing and reporting.
Chase any consumer that has not acknowledged.
Done when every downstream acknowledgment has been read.
verify: Re-read the interface log after any chase.
Pass when every downstream consumer has acknowledged the termination.

steps.title: Return incomplete cases to processing
sop: Identify cases with an outstanding step in policy, billing or notices.
Return each case to processing with the outstanding step named.
Done when every incomplete case has been returned.
verify: Re-check the returned cases before completion.
Pass when no case is marked complete with an outstanding step.

steps.title: Close the cancellation work item with the completion date
sop: Record the completion date on the cancellation work item.
Close the item with the cancellation outcome code.
Done when the item is closed with a completion date and outcome.
verify: Reopen the closed item and read the completion block.
Pass when completion date and outcome code are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellations and non-renewals requiring a statutory advance-notice determination.
generic.In-scope period: The notice window counted back from the intended cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk state, line, reason, notice days and source reference populated on the transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of notice determinations equals the count of cancellations awaiting notice generation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice-day requirement and source reference recorded with the lookup date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Effective dates set inside the notice window logged and moved out with approval.
generic.Test population: All cancellations and non-renewals with a notice determination in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No cancellation effective date is set inside the state advance-notice window.
generic.Exception handling path: Move the effective date out to the earliest permissible date and reissue the notice.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice-period requirement recorded with state, line and reason on the transaction.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation transaction in the administration system and the lookup record on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Look up advance-notice days for state, line and reason
sop: Read the risk state, line of business and cancellation reason.
Look up the advance-notice days required for that combination.
Done when the required notice days are established.
verify: Re-read the source reference used for the lookup.
Pass when the notice days match the state requirement for that reason.

steps.title: Confirm whether the reason shortens or lengthens the notice period
sop: Compare non-payment and underwriting reasons against the notice rules.
Select the notice period matching the actual reason recorded.
Done when the reason-specific notice period is selected.
verify: Re-read the reason code on the transaction.
Pass when the notice period selected matches the recorded reason.

steps.title: Count back to derive the latest permissible despatch date
sop: Subtract the notice days from the intended cancellation effective date.
Record the latest permissible despatch date on the transaction.
Done when the despatch deadline is recorded.
verify: Recompute the deadline from the effective date and notice days.
Pass when the recorded deadline matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Check the state-required reason wording and appeal-rights language
sop: Read the state requirements for reason wording and appeal-rights text.
Record the required wording for use in the notice.
Done when the required wording has been recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded wording to the state requirement.
Pass when the wording recorded matches the state requirement.

steps.title: Record the notice-day requirement and source on the transaction
sop: Enter the notice days, the source reference and the lookup date on the transaction.
Attach the lookup evidence where available.
Done when the requirement and source are recorded.
verify: Reopen the transaction and read the notice block.
Pass when notice days, state, line and reason are all retrievable.

steps.title: Move effective dates that fall inside the notice window
sop: Compare the intended effective date to the despatch deadline.
Move the effective date out where the window cannot be met.
Done when every effective date respects the notice window.
verify: Recompute the notice days for the final effective date.
Pass when no effective date sits inside the state advance-notice window.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancelled policies with a calculated return premium due for disbursement or credit.
generic.In-scope period: Disbursements made within the return premium service standard after cancellation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee of record, refund method, payee address or bank details and amount populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disbursed amount equals the calculated return premium less any earned balance offset.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Disbursement reference and date recorded on the cancellation transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Payee mismatches and returned payments logged with the reissue outcome.
generic.Test population: All return premium disbursements made in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No refund is released to the insured where a premium finance company is the payor of record.
generic.Exception handling path: Stop the disbursement and reissue to the correct payor of record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Return premium disbursed or credited to the payor of record with a reference on file.
generic.Evidence location: Disbursement record in Guidewire BillingCenter and the cancellation transaction.

steps.title: Identify the premium payor of record on the account
sop: Read the payor of record on the billing account.
Confirm whether it is the insured, a premium finance company or a mortgagee.
Done when the payor of record is identified.
verify: Compare the payor to the payment history on the account.
Pass when the identified payor matches who paid the premium.

steps.title: Offset the return premium against any earned balance
sop: Read the outstanding earned balance on the cancelled term.
Offset the return premium against that balance before refunding.
Done when the offset has been applied.
verify: Recompute the net refund after the offset.
Pass when the refund equals return premium less the earned balance.

steps.title: Select the refund method matching the original payment
sop: Read the original payment method on the account.
Select the matching refund method where the rules require it.
Done when the refund method has been selected.
verify: Compare the refund method to the original payment method.
Pass when the refund method matches where matching is required.

steps.title: Verify payee address or bank details before release
sop: Read the payee address or bank details held on the account.
Confirm they are current before releasing the disbursement.
Done when the payee details have been verified.
verify: Re-read the details against the account record.
Pass when the payee details on the disbursement match the account record.

steps.title: Release the disbursement or apply the credit
sop: Release the refund to the payor of record or apply it as an account credit.
Confirm the transaction posts without error.
Done when the disbursement or credit has been applied.
verify: Read the posted disbursement on the account.
Pass when the disbursement posted to the correct payor of record.

steps.title: Record the disbursement reference and date on the transaction
sop: Enter the disbursement reference, amount and date on the cancellation transaction.
Attach the payment confirmation to the transaction.
Done when the reference and date are recorded.
verify: Reopen the cancellation transaction.
Pass when the disbursement reference and date are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellation notices due to the insured and every listed lienholder and additional interest.
generic.In-scope period: The statutory notice period before the cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recipient list, mailing addresses, despatch method and despatch date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of notices despatched equals the insured plus every listed interest holder.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certificate of mailing or tracking record retained with the despatch date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable or omitted recipients logged with the resend and its date.
generic.Test population: All cancellation notice distributions in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No listed additional interest is omitted from the notice distribution.
generic.Exception handling path: Resend to the omitted interest and reassess the cancellation effective date for the notice period.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Proof of mailing on file for the insured and every listed lienholder.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation transaction delivery record and the mailing proofs in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Build the recipient list from the policy record
sop: List the insured plus every mortgagee, lienholder and additional interest on the policy.
Read the current notice address for each recipient.
Done when the recipient list with addresses is built.
verify: Compare the list to the policy additional interest schedule.
Pass when every listed interest appears on the recipient list.

steps.title: Confirm the state-required despatch method
sop: Read the despatch method the state requires for cancellation notices.
Select certified mail or proof of mailing as required.
Done when the required despatch method is selected.
verify: Compare the selected method to the state requirement.
Pass when the despatch method meets the state requirement.

steps.title: Check the despatch date leaves the full statutory notice period
sop: Compare the planned despatch date to the notice deadline on the transaction.
Escalate where the deadline cannot be met.
Done when the despatch date has been checked against the deadline.
verify: Recompute the days between despatch and effective date.
Pass when the full statutory notice period remains after despatch.

steps.title: Despatch the notice to the insured and every interest holder
sop: Send the notice to the insured mailing address of record.
Send a copy to every listed mortgagee, lienholder and additional interest.
Done when every recipient has been despatched a notice.
verify: Recount despatches against the recipient list.
Pass when despatch count equals the recipient list count.

steps.title: Retain the certificate of mailing or tracking record
sop: Collect the certificate of mailing or carrier tracking record for each despatch.
File each proof in OpenText indexed to the policy and cancellation.
Done when a proof is filed for every despatch.
verify: Retrieve the proof for a sample of recipients.
Pass when proof of mailing exists for the insured and every lienholder.

steps.title: Record despatch date, method and recipients on the transaction
sop: Enter despatch date, method and each recipient on the cancellation transaction.
Attach the proof references to the record.
Done when the despatch details are recorded on the transaction.
verify: Reopen the cancellation transaction delivery record.
Pass when date, method and every recipient are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellation and non-renewal notices required for policies with a validated termination trigger.
generic.In-scope period: Notices generated ahead of the statutory despatch deadline for the effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason wording, effective date and time, return premium statement and appeal language populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of notices generated equals the count of validated cancellation triggers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated notice retained with template version and generation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices generated without a stated reason logged and regenerated on the correct template.
generic.Test population: All cancellation and non-renewal notices generated in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No notice is issued without a stated reason where the state requires one.
generic.Exception handling path: Discard the notice and regenerate from the current state template before despatch.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice on the current state template showing reason, date and required language.
generic.Evidence location: Notice document in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the cancellation transaction.

steps.title: Select the state-specific notice template for the reason
sop: Read the risk state and the validated cancellation reason.
Select the matching cancellation or non-renewal template.
Done when the correct state template is selected.
verify: Compare the template identifier to the state template register.
Pass when the selected template is the current state version.

steps.title: Generate the notice from the policy record
sop: Run generation from the policy record so insured and policy data merge.
Do not build the notice from a blank document.
Done when the notice is generated from the policy record.
verify: Scan the notice for unresolved merge placeholders.
Pass when the notice contains no unresolved placeholders.

steps.title: Confirm the reason is stated in the state-required wording
sop: Read the reason wording on the generated notice.
Compare it to the state-required wording recorded at notice determination.
Done when the reason wording has been compared.
verify: Re-read the wording after any regeneration.
Pass when the notice states the reason in the state-required wording.

steps.title: Check the effective date, time and return premium statement
sop: Read the cancellation effective date and time on the notice.
Confirm the return premium statement appears where required.
Done when date, time and return premium statement have been read.
verify: Compare the notice date and time to the transaction.
Pass when the notice date and time match the cancellation transaction.

steps.title: Verify appeal or complaint-department language is present
sop: Check the state requirement for appeal or complaint-department text.
Confirm the required text appears on the notice.
Done when the appeal-language check has been completed.
verify: Re-read the notice footer after regeneration.
Pass when required appeal or complaint language is present.

steps.title: File the generated notice against the cancellation transaction
sop: Attach the generated notice to the cancellation transaction in the document list.
Index it in OpenText to the policy and term.
Done when the notice is filed and indexed.
verify: Search the policy document list for the notice.
Pass when the generated notice is retrievable against the cancellation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellations requiring capture in the market-conduct and statistical regulatory extracts.
generic.In-scope period: The regulatory reporting period containing the cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Structured reason code, cancellation effective date and notice despatch date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of cancellations on the regulatory extract equals the count posted in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract output retained with its run date and the reporting period stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reason codes rejected by extract validation logged and corrected before the filing deadline.

steps.title: Record the structured cancellation reason code

Replace any free-text reason with the structured code.

steps.title: Confirm the code maps to the market-conduct category

steps.title: Check the effective and notice despatch dates are captured

steps.title: Verify the cancellation appears in the statistical extract

Done when the cancellation is confirmed on the extract.
verify: Read the period stamp on the extract row.
Pass when the cancellation appears in the correct reporting period.

steps.title: Correct reason codes rejected by extract validation

Correct the reason code and resubmit before the filing deadline.

verify: Re-run the validation after correction.
Pass when no cancellation is excluded due to an invalid reason code.

steps.title: Reconcile extract counts to cancellations posted in the period

Compare that count to the extract row count.

verify: Recompute the comparison after any re-run.

steps.title: Create the cancellation work item and attach the source trigger
sop: Create the work item against the policy and current term.
Attach the signed request, lost-policy release or system non-pay flag.
Done when the work item exists with its source trigger attached.

steps.title: Select the reason code from the controlled list

Confirm the code is permitted in the risk state before saving.

verify: Re-read the permitted-code list for the state.
Pass when the recorded reason code is permitted in the risk state.

steps.title: Confirm signature or verified verbal authorisation for insured requests
sop: Check the insured-requested trigger carries a signature or verified verbal record.
Hold the request where neither exists.

verify: Re-read the authorisation evidence on the work item.
Pass when every insured-requested cancellation carries authorisation evidence.

steps.title: Confirm the unpaid instalment for non-payment triggers
sop: Open the billing account for a non-payment trigger.
Read the unpaid instalment amount and its due date.

verify: Compare the recorded amount to the billing account.
Pass when the recorded unpaid instalment matches the billing account.

steps.title: Record the requested cancellation effective date
sop: Enter the requested cancellation effective date on the work item.
Flag the request where it asks for a backdated effective date.
Done when the date is recorded and any backdate flagged.
verify: Re-read the date and backdate flag.
Pass when backdated requests carry the backdate flag.

steps.title: Refuse triggers on reason codes not permitted in the state
sop: Compare each reason code to the permitted list for the risk state.
Refuse and return triggers on non-permitted codes.
Done when every non-permitted trigger is refused.
verify: Re-run the permitted-code check on open triggers.
Pass when no cancellation is raised on a non-permitted reason code.

steps.title: Check for open claims with loss dates before cancellation

Identify claims with loss dates before the cancellation effective date.
Done when the open claim population is identified.
verify: Recount the identified claims against the claims listing.
Pass when every open claim on the policy has been assessed.

steps.title: Send the claims notification with policy, date and reason
sop: Send the notification stating policy number, cancellation effective date and reason.
Route it through the workflow tool so it is traceable.
Done when the notification has been sent.
verify: Read the sent notification content.
Pass when the notification states policy number, effective date and reason.

steps.title: Confirm claims recorded the coverage end date
sop: Ask claims to confirm the coverage end date on each open claim.
Record the confirmation against the cancellation transaction.
Done when the coverage end date confirmation is received.
verify: Re-read the claim record coverage end date.
Pass when claims recorded the coverage end date on the open claims.

steps.title: Flag claims with loss dates after the cancellation date
sop: Identify claims whose loss date falls after the cancellation effective date.
Flag each for coverage review by claims.
Done when every such claim has been flagged.
verify: Re-read the flag status on affected claims.
Pass when every post-cancellation loss date claim carries a coverage review flag.

steps.title: Confirm claims acknowledged the notification
sop: Read the acknowledgment status on the notification record.
Chase claims where no acknowledgment is received.
Done when acknowledgment is received or a chase is logged.
verify: Re-read the acknowledgment after any chase.
Pass when the claims notification is acknowledged rather than assumed.

steps.title: Record the notification reference and date on the transaction
sop: Enter the notification reference and acknowledgment date on the transaction.
Attach the notification record to the transaction.
Done when reference and date are recorded.
verify: Reopen the cancellation transaction.
Pass when the notification reference and date are retrievable.

generic.Evidence location: Interface log in the workflow tool and the cancellation transaction in the administration system.

steps.title: Confirm the termination extract fired to all downstream consumers
sop: Open the interface log and filter to the cancelled policy.
Confirm messages exist for billing, claims, reinsurance and statistical reporting.
Done when a message is confirmed for each consumer.
verify: Recount messages against the consumer list.
Pass when a termination message exists for every downstream consumer.

steps.title: Check state-required electronic termination filings transmitted
sop: Identify state filings required such as financial responsibility or workers compensation.
Confirm each required filing was transmitted.
Done when every required state filing is confirmed transmitted.
verify: Read the filing transmission confirmation.
Pass when every required state termination filing was transmitted.

steps.title: Verify acknowledgment for each downstream consumer
sop: Read the acknowledgment status for each message on the interface log.
Chase any consumer without an acknowledgment.
Done when every message has an acknowledgment or a logged chase.
verify: Re-read the log after the chase run.
Pass when every downstream consumer acknowledged the termination.

steps.title: Reprocess rejected termination messages
sop: List rejected messages and read their reject reasons.
Correct the source data and resubmit each message.
Done when every rejected message has been resubmitted.
verify: Read the status of resubmitted messages.
Pass when no termination message remains unresolved on the error queue.

steps.title: Escalate persistent interface failures
sop: Identify messages that failed after resubmission.
Escalate each to the interface owner with the reject detail.
Done when every persistent failure has been escalated.
verify: Re-read the escalation outcome on the interface log.
Pass when every persistent failure carries a logged escalation.

steps.title: Record notification references and dates on the transaction
sop: Enter each consumer reference and acknowledgment date on the cancellation transaction.
Attach the interface log extract to the transaction.
Done when references and dates are recorded.
verify: Reopen the cancellation transaction notification block.
Pass when references and acknowledgment dates are retrievable per consumer.

generic.Defined scope/population: Mortgagees, loss payees and lienholders listed on a cancelling policy.
generic.In-scope period: The lienholder notice period required before the cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Interest holder name, notice address, notice period and despatch method populated.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Interest holders notified late or with stale addresses logged with the corrective action.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Evidence of cancellation issued and logged for every listed lienholder.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation record in the administration system and the certificates in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: List every interest holder with the current notice address
sop: Open the additional interest schedule on the policy.
List each mortgagee, loss payee and lienholder with its notice address.
Done when the interest holder list is complete.
verify: Compare the list to the policy additional interest schedule.
Pass when every listed interest appears with a notice address.

steps.title: Generate the evidence of cancellation certificate for each holder
sop: Generate the certificate naming the policy, holder and cancellation date.
Produce one certificate per interest holder.
Done when a certificate exists for every holder.
verify: Recount certificates against the holder list.
Pass when the certificate count equals the holder count.

steps.title: Apply the lienholder notice period where it differs
sop: Read the notice period stated in each lienholder agreement.
Apply the longer of the lienholder and insured notice periods.
Done when the applicable notice period is set per holder.
verify: Recompute despatch deadlines per holder.
Pass when each holder despatch meets its own notice period.

steps.title: Despatch by the method named in the lienholder agreement
sop: Read the despatch method required by each lienholder agreement.
Despatch each certificate by that method.
Done when every certificate has been despatched on the required method.
verify: Compare the despatch method used to each agreement.
Pass when every despatch used the method named in the agreement.

steps.title: Retain the mailing proof for each despatch
sop: Collect the mailing proof for each lienholder despatch.
File each proof indexed to the policy and the interest holder.
Done when a proof is filed for every despatch.
verify: Retrieve the proof for a sample of holders.
Pass when a mailing proof exists for every notified holder.

steps.title: Record each holder notified and the despatch date
sop: Record each interest holder and its despatch date against the cancellation.
Flag any holder not yet despatched.
Done when every holder is recorded with a despatch date.
verify: Reopen the cancellation record notification list.
Pass when every listed lienholder shows a logged despatch date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recurring EFT and card authorisations on billing accounts for cancelled policy terms.
generic.In-scope period: Draft dates on or after the cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authorisation status, stop date and removed authorisation reference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of authorisations stopped equals the count active on cancelled terms.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Drafts taken after cancellation logged with the reversal and refund reference.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No automated draft is taken from the insured after the cancellation effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Reverse the draft and refund the insured, then log the control failure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recurring authorisation stopped with a recorded stop date.
generic.Evidence location: Billing account payment plan record in Guidewire BillingCenter and the account notes.

steps.title: Locate the recurring authorisation on the billing account
sop: Open the billing account and read the recurring EFT or card authorisation.
Note the authorisation reference and its next draft date.
Done when the authorisation and next draft date are identified.
verify: Compare the authorisation to the cancelled term.
Pass when the identified authorisation belongs to the cancelled term.

steps.title: Cancel the recurring authorisation in BillingCenter
sop: Cancel the recurring authorisation for the cancelled term.
Confirm the cancellation saves against the account.
Done when the authorisation is cancelled.
verify: Re-read the authorisation record.
Pass when the recurring authorisation shows cancelled.

steps.title: Confirm no draft is scheduled after the cancellation effective date
sop: Read the forward draft schedule for the account.
Remove any draft dated on or after the cancellation effective date.
Done when the forward schedule holds no post-cancellation draft.
verify: Re-read the forward draft schedule.
Pass when no draft is scheduled after the cancellation effective date.

steps.title: Check the payment plan status reads Stopped
sop: Read the automated payment plan status on the account.

Done when the plan status reads Stopped.
verify: Re-read the plan status field.
Pass when the automated payment plan reads Stopped and not Suspended.

steps.title: Reverse and refund any draft taken after cancellation
sop: Identify drafts that pulled after the cancellation effective date.
Reverse each draft and refund the insured.
Done when every post-cancellation draft has been reversed and refunded.
verify: Re-read the account transactions after the reversals.
Pass when no post-cancellation draft remains unreversed.

steps.title: Record the stop date and removed authorisation reference
sop: Record the stop date and the removed authorisation reference on the account notes.
Attach the cancellation confirmation from the payment provider where available.
Done when the stop date and reference are recorded.
verify: Reopen the account notes.
Pass when the stop date and authorisation reference are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Return premium adjustments on cancelled terms awaiting transmission to billing and collections.
generic.In-scope period: Adjustments effective from the cancellation effective date in the current posting cycle.

steps.title: Transmit the return premium adjustment to the billing ledger

verify: Read the transmission status on the interface log.
Pass when the adjustment transmitted without error.

steps.title: Confirm the adjustment posted to the correct term and account
sop: Open the billing account and locate the posted adjustment.

verify: Re-read the posting detail on the ledger.

steps.title: Check the resulting balance equals earned premium less cash received

steps.title: Clear suspense items created by the adjustment
sop: Filter the suspense report to the policy and billing account.
Clear each item created by the adjustment within the suspense standard.

verify: Re-run the suspense filter for the account.
Pass when no adjustment remains in suspense beyond the clearance standard.

Pass the balance to collections with the cancellation context.

verify: Read the collections queue entry for the account.
Pass when any remaining earned balance is visible to collections.

steps.title: Record the transmission reference on the cancellation transaction
sop: Enter the transmission reference and posting date on the transaction.
Attach the ledger posting evidence.
Done when the reference and date are recorded.
verify: Reopen the cancellation transaction.
Pass when the transmission reference and posting date are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies with a despatched cancellation or non-renewal notice awaiting a status update.

steps.title: Set the policy status to Cancelled or Non-Renewed

steps.title: Enter the effective date and time from the despatched notice
sop: Read the effective date and time stated on the despatched notice.

verify: Compare the system date and time to the notice.

steps.title: Confirm the status change carries the validated reason code
sop: Read the reason code recorded at trigger validation.
Confirm the status change carries the same code.

verify: Re-read the reason code on the status change.

steps.title: Check the policy drops off the in-force listing

verify: Re-run the listing after the status change commits.

steps.title: Verify prior in-force history remains intact
sop: Open the policy history after the status change.
Confirm prior in-force terms and transactions remain viewable.
Done when the prior history has been confirmed intact.
verify: Open a prior term from the history.
Pass when the prior in-force history opens with its values intact.

steps.title: Reconcile system date against the notice for the batch
sop: Compare system cancellation dates to notice dates across the batch.
Correct any mismatch or reissue the notice as required.
Done when every mismatch has been resolved.
verify: Re-run the date comparison across the batch.
Pass when no system date differs from the date on the issued notice.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cancellation requests requiring an authority check before the termination is executed.

steps.title: Confirm the reason is permitted after the underwriting freeze period

verify: Re-read the freeze rule relied upon.
Pass when the reason is permitted at this stage of the term in that state.

steps.title: Check the cancelling user authority against the matrix
sop: Read the user performing the carrier-initiated cancellation.
Compare their authority level to the matrix requirement.

steps.title: Confirm the signed request or lost-policy release for insured cancellations
sop: Locate the signed request or lost-policy release on the file.

verify: Open the located document.
Pass when insured-requested cancellations carry a signed request or release.

verify: Re-read the restriction source relied upon.
Pass when no restriction blocks the cancellation being executed.

steps.title: Escalate cancellations outside the matrix to an authorised approver
sop: Identify cancellations attempted by users outside the matrix.
Route each to an authorised approver before execution.
Done when every out-of-matrix case has been escalated.
verify: Re-read the approver recorded on escalated cases.
Pass when no carrier-initiated cancellation executes outside the matrix.

steps.title: Record the authority reference and approver on the transaction
sop: Enter the authority matrix reference and the approver name on the transaction.
Record the approval date alongside.

verify: Reopen the cancellation transaction authority block.

sop: Read the current appetite and eligibility rules for the product.

verify: Re-read the rule version used.

verify: Read the referral outcome on referred cases.

verify: Reopen the request and read the file note.
Pass when the decision and rationale are retrievable with assessor and date.

steps.title: Attach the gap loss review to the reinstatement request
sop: Attach the gap-period loss extract to the reinstatement request.

verify: Open the attachment from the request.
Pass when the gap loss review opens against the reinstatement request.

sop: Record each evaluated option and its value on the policy file.

steps.title: Reconcile register entries to replacement transactions processed
sop: Count the replacement transactions processed in the period.
Compare that count to the register entry count.
Done when the two counts have been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any addition.
Pass when no replacement transaction is absent from the register.

steps.title: Record the compliance notification reference and date
sop: Enter the compliance notification reference and date on the exchange case.
Attach the acknowledgment evidence.
Done when the reference and date are recorded.
verify: Reopen the exchange case compliance block.
Pass when the compliance reference and date are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prior coverage being replaced by an issued converted or exchanged contract.
generic.In-scope period: Termination effective from the new contract effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Termination effective date, reason code Converted or Exchanged and status populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of terminations equals the count of replacement contracts confirmed in force.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Termination transaction retained with the full prior contract history intact.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage gaps or overlaps logged with the date correction applied.
generic.Test population: All prior coverages terminated for replacement in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No gap or double coverage exists between the terminated and replacement contracts.
generic.Exception handling path: Correct the termination date so it aligns exactly with the new contract effective date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prior coverage terminated with a Converted or Exchanged reason aligned to the new date.
generic.Evidence location: Prior contract record and history in Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Confirm the new contract is issued and in force
sop: Read the new contract status in the administration system.
Hold the termination until the new contract is in force.
Done when the new contract status is confirmed in force.
verify: Re-read the new contract status before terminating.
Pass when no prior coverage is terminated before the new contract is in force.

steps.title: Set the termination effective date to the new contract date
sop: Read the new contract effective date.
Set the termination effective date to align exactly with it.
Done when the termination date is aligned.
verify: Compare the two dates.
Pass when the termination date aligns exactly with the new contract effective date.

steps.title: Select the Converted or Exchanged termination reason code
sop: Select Converted or Exchanged as the termination reason.
Do not use a lapse or cancel reason code.
Done when the correct reason code is selected.
verify: Re-read the reason code on the termination.
Pass when the reason is Converted or Exchanged and not lapse or cancel.

steps.title: Check for coverage gaps or overlaps between contracts
sop: Compare the prior contract termination date to the new contract effective date.
Correct the dates where a gap or overlap exists.
Done when the date comparison has been performed.
verify: Recompute the day difference between the contracts.
Pass when no gap or double coverage exists between the contracts.

steps.title: Confirm the terminated contract retains its full history
sop: Open the terminated contract history after the termination posts.
Confirm the history is intact and not purged.
Done when the history has been confirmed intact.
verify: Open a prior transaction from the terminated contract history.
Pass when the terminated contract history opens with its records intact.

steps.title: Record the termination on the exchange case
sop: Record the termination date and reason on the exchange case.
Attach the termination transaction reference.
Done when the termination is recorded on the case.
verify: Reopen the exchange case termination block.
Pass when the termination date and reason are retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: 1035 exchange paperwork and replacement disclosures submitted with exchange requests.
generic.In-scope period: Paperwork submitted in the current exchange intake period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signed assignment, transfer form, replacement notice and comparison statement populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of complete paperwork sets equals the count of exchanges progressed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed forms retained in OpenText with their signature dates and versions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Incomplete paperwork returned to the producer as an open requirement with the outcome.
generic.Test population: All exchange paperwork sets validated in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No exchange is processed with a replacement notice dated after the application signature.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the paperwork to the producer and hold the case as an open requirement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed assignment and current-version disclosures on file and dated correctly.
generic.Evidence location: Exchange paperwork in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the case in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Confirm the signed 1035 assignment and transfer form are on file
sop: Locate the signed absolute assignment and the ceding carrier transfer form.
Hold the case where either is missing.
Done when both forms are located or the case is held.
verify: Open both located forms.
Pass when the signed assignment and transfer form are both on file.

steps.title: Check the state replacement notice is the current version
sop: Read the version identifier on the state replacement notice.
Compare it to the current approved version for the state.
Done when the version has been compared.
verify: Re-read the version after any resubmission.
Pass when the replacement notice is the current state version.

steps.title: Confirm the notice is signed and dated by owner and producer
sop: Read the signature and date blocks on the replacement notice.
Return the notice where either party has not signed or dated.
Done when both signatures and dates have been checked.
verify: Re-read the signature blocks after resubmission.
Pass when the notice is signed and dated by both owner and producer.

steps.title: Confirm the comparison statement is completed
sop: Read the comparison statement of existing and proposed contract values.
Return the paperwork where the comparison is blank.
Done when the comparison statement has been checked.
verify: Re-read the comparison after resubmission.
Pass when the comparison statement is completed and not blank.

steps.title: Verify the notice date precedes the application signature date
sop: Read the replacement notice date and the application signature date.
Compare the two dates.
Done when the two dates have been compared.
verify: Recompute the date comparison after any resubmission.
Pass when the notice date is on or before the application signature date.

steps.title: Return incomplete paperwork as an open requirement
sop: Return incomplete paperwork to the producer with the deficiency stated.
Record it as an open requirement rather than processing on a promise.
Done when every deficiency is returned and tracked.
verify: Re-read the open requirement list before processing.
Pass when no exchange is processed with outstanding paperwork deficiencies.

generic.Defined scope/population: Term contracts with a conversion request requiring an eligibility determination.
generic.In-scope period: The conversion period stated in the original contract provision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Conversion expiry date, attained age, requested product and provision reference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of eligibility determinations equals the count of conversion requests validated.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Eligibility confirmation with the provision relied on recorded before quoting.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests outside the conversion period or age limit declined and the declination logged.
generic.Test population: All conversion requests assessed for eligibility in the sample period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No conversion is accepted after the conversion period or attained-age limit has expired.
generic.Exception handling path: Decline the conversion and notify the owner of the expired privilege.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Eligibility confirmed against the provision, attained age and product availability.
generic.Evidence location: Conversion case on the underwriting workstation and the contract provision in the administration system.

steps.title: Read the conversion privilege provision on the original contract
sop: Open the original contract and read the conversion privilege provision.
Record the conversion expiry date and any age limit.
Done when the provision terms are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded terms to the contract provision.
Pass when the recorded expiry and age limit match the provision.

steps.title: Confirm the request date falls inside the conversion period
sop: Compare the conversion request date to the conversion expiry date.
Decline where the period has expired.
Done when the request date has been compared.
verify: Recompute the comparison from the two dates.
Pass when the request falls inside the conversion period.

steps.title: Check the attained age against the age limit
sop: Calculate the insured attained age at the request date.
Compare it to the attained-age limit in the provision.
Done when the attained age has been compared.
verify: Recompute the attained age from the date of birth.
Pass when the attained age is within the provision limit.

steps.title: Confirm the requested permanent product is available in the state
sop: Read the product availability for conversion in the owner state.
Confirm the requested product is open for conversion there.
Done when product availability has been confirmed.
verify: Re-read the availability record for the state.
Pass when the requested product is available for conversion in the state.

steps.title: Confirm no evidence of insurability is being required in error
sop: Read whether the privilege provides conversion without evidence.
Remove any evidence requirement raised where the privilege exempts it.
Done when the evidence position has been confirmed.
verify: Re-read the open requirement list on the case.
Pass when no evidence requirement stands where the privilege exempts it.

steps.title: Record the eligibility confirmation with the provision relied on
sop: Enter the eligibility outcome and the provision reference on the case.
Record the determination date before the conversion is quoted.
Done when the confirmation is recorded.
verify: Reopen the case eligibility block.
Pass when the eligibility outcome and provision reference are retrievable.
